title: Gen AI Automation
jobDescription:
Role & responsibilities:

Experienced Automation Specialist to lead initiatives that improve end-user computing operations and enhance user experience through intelligent automation.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in Generative AI (GenAI) and Agentic AI, and a strong background in scripting, infrastructure automation, and workflow orchestration.

GenAI & Agentic AI Automation
• Design and implement agentic AI workflows that autonomously manage provisioning, compliance, and remediation tasks.
• Deploy GenAI-powered virtual agents to support ticket triage, contextual help, and predictive issue resolution.
• Use AI-driven telemetry and analytics to monitor user experience and trigger automated responses.
• Integrate GenAI tools into EUC platforms to improve self-service and reduce manual workload.
Automation & Scripting
• Develop PowerShell and Python scripts to automate provisioning, patching, and reporting.
• Use Terraform to define and manage infrastructure-as-code for hybrid and cloud environments.
• Maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and other DevOps tools.
Workflow Orchestration
• Build business process automation using Power Automate and Microsoft 365 tools.
• Integrate platforms such as ServiceNow, Teams, and Intune to streamline workflows and notifications.
Monitoring & Optimization
• Track system performance and user experience metrics.
• Identify automation opportunities and lead continuous improvement initiatives.

Documentation & Enablement
• Create technical documentation, SOPs, and user guides.
• Train IT staff and end users on new tools, workflows, and AI capabilities.

Essential Skills:
• Experience with GenAI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, or similar)
• Hands-on knowledge of agentic AI design and orchestration
• Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Python, and Terraform
• Familiarity with GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices
• Proficiency in Microsoft 365, Intune, Azure, and Active Directory
• Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills

Desirable Skills:
• Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals
• OpenAI Developer Certification or equivalent
• Agentic AI Automation Specialist certification
• Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator
• HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
• Experience with ServiceNow and endpoint management tools
• Understanding of Agile and ITIL frameworks

jobDescription:
Role: Senior Machine Learning Engineer

Location: Vashi, Navi Mumbai (4 days in a week from office)

Work timings: Office work from 12:00pm to 5:00pm and then remote 7:30pm to 10:00pm


Job Overview

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, AI & ML Data Collection, you will play a critical role in building and scaling the companys Unified AI/ML Data Collection Platform, enabling standardized, reliable, and scalable machine learning capabilities across the organization. This role will focus on transforming existing AI/ML and LLM-driven data systems into a cohesive platform that supports data pipelines, model lifecycle management, evaluation frameworks, and production deployment.

This position requires deep hands-on expertise in machine learning engineering, LLM-based systems, ML platform development, and MLOps. You will work closely with ML engineers, product managers, researchers, and business stakeholders to deliver production-ready AI/ML systems aligned with broader business objectives and AI/ML strategy.

You will be deeply involved in the design, development, and operationalization of platform components, including data ingestion, feature management, model training and evaluation, scalable inference systems, and model observability capabilities.

You will help ensure that AI/ML systems are production-ready, observable, maintainable, and cost-efficient, with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, governance, and developer productivity. You will leverage your expertise in areas such as large language models (LLM), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and ML Operations (MLOps).

You will contribute to the end-to-end lifecycle of ML systems, from experimentation and prototyping to deployment, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement while mentoring engineers and promoting strong engineering practices across the team.

Team Overview

You will be part of a multidisciplinary team of ML engineers responsible for building and maintaining the Unified AI/ML Data Collection Platform. The team focuses on developing scalable systems that support data pipelines, model lifecycle management, LLM-based workflows, and evaluation frameworks, enabling downstream teams to build and deploy AI-driven data collection solutions.

Outline of Duties and Responsibilities

  • AI-Powered Data Collection Systems: Design and develop scalable AI-driven data collection and enrichment workflows across structured and unstructured data sources.
  • LLM & Generative AI Workflows: Build LLM-based capabilities including RAG systems, prompt orchestration, entity extraction, summarization, classification, and automated validation workflows.
  • Agentic Frameworks & Model Context Integration: Design and implement agentic workflows and model-to-tool integrations that connect AI models with internal tools, APIs, knowledge stores, data sources, and workflow systems.
  • Model Deployment & Lifecycle Management: Deploy, maintain, and optimize ML and LLM models in production, including model versioning, CI/CD, experiment tracking, model registry, rollout strategies, and rollback mechanisms.
  • Data Quality & Evaluation: Build frameworks for evaluating extraction quality, model performance, hallucination risks, grounding, consistency, latency, coverage, and overall data reliability.
  • Observability & Operational Excellence: Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, cost tracking, model performance monitoring, drift detection, and reliability dashboards for production AI/ML systems.
  • Scalable Platform Engineering: Design distributed, event-driven, and cloud-native systems using asynchronous processing, message queues, containerization, and orchestration patterns to support high-volume workloads.
  • Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Evaluate emerging AI/ML technologies, LLM frameworks, orchestration tools, vector databases, and model deployment approaches to improve automation capabilities and developer productivity.
  • Company Values: Model company values and contribute to a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

Experience, Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering or data science, with a focus on machine learning systems, ML platforms, or distributed systems.
  • Strong experience building production-grade ML systems, including model deployment and lifecycle management.
  • Hands-on experience with MLOps tools and practices, including CI/CD, model monitoring, and experiment tracking.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, or similar languages.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and containerization (e.g., AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with LLM-based systems in production, including RAG pipelines, embeddings, and vector databases.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and system design trade-offs.
  • Proven ability to solve complex technical challenges and deliver scalable solutions.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across global teams.
  • Experience working in fast-paced, data-driven environments.

Working Conditions

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phones on an ongoing basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

jobDescription:
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Reliability, you will serve as a hands-on technical leader within the SRE team, guiding senior engineers, influencing product development teams, and ensuring the systems we operate are built to be reliable, scalable, and observable from the ground up.

You will drive strategic initiatives, mentor others in the practice of SRE, and help define architectural best practices across our platform. This role is pivotal in aligning teams, enforcing high standards, and scaling SRE principles globally within Veeam.

Reliability Engineering Resilience

  • Design and evolve infrastructure to be highly available, fault tolerant, and scalable across public clouds (initially Azure, with future expansion plans to other providers).
  • Establish and maintain SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets that define and enforce reliability objectives.
  • Lead incident response, analysis, blameless postmortems, and sharing sessions in order to maximize learning across our entire engineering team and driving changes to the entire socio-technical engineering system.

Observability Operational Excellence

  • Drive adoption of deep observability practices, ensuring telemetry, logs, metrics, and tracing are comprehensive and actionable.
  • Develop automation and self-healing tools to reduce toil and support Veeams fleet management strategy.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and lead operational excellence across the stack.

Engineering at Scale

  • Contribute to infrastructure as code (IaC), CI/CD systems, deployment automation, and scalable config management.
  • Integrate and extend monitoring and chaos engineering tools to validate reliability assumptions under load and failure conditions.
  • Implement testing strategies, canary deployments, and release validation pipelines to protect production environments and allow teams to safely deliver new features as quickly as possible.

Collaboration Culture

  • Embed within product and platform teams to champion reliability from design through delivery.
  • Contribute to a learning culture focused on continuous improvement and proactive risk management.
  • Mentor engineers and advocate for DevOps/SRE best practices across global teams.
What Youll Bring
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in a Software Engineering role with at least 2 years in Site Reliability, Platform Engineering, or similar.
  • Deep experience building systems on public cloud providers (Azure preferred)
  • Strong programming skills in JS, Node, Typescript, Go, Java, C#, or similar.
  • Proven track record in delivering monitoring, alerting, and observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).

The Senior Analyst, Regulatory Affairs is responsible for supporting regulatory intelligence and regulatory change management activities to help maintain compliance with global regulatory requirements. The role monitors emerging regulations, assesses potential impacts on products and business processes, and partners with cross-functional teams to support timely implementation of compliance actions. The position contributes to regulatory compliance programs that minimize business disruption, regulatory risk, and potential delays to product commercialization and distribution. Develop and deliver periodic regulatory intelligence reports and presentations for management review.

  • Experience conducting regulatory assessments and translating regulatory requirements into actionable business recommendations and managing or supporting compliance-related projects in a cross-functional environment.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience supporting audits, inspections, or interactions with regulatory authorities and notified bodies.
  • Experience leveraging AI or automation tools to improve regulatory intelligence workflows.

title: Technical Project Manager-(CCAAS & Voice BOT Delivery)
jobDescription:
About Exotel

Exotel is the emerging market s leading AI-powered Customer Engagement Platform, enabling enterprises to engage customers seamlessly across Voice, Messaging, Video, Contact Centre and Conversational AI. Trusted by over 6,000 businesses across 60+ countries-including Ola, Swiggy, Flipkart, HDFC Bank and Zomato-Exotel powers more than 50 million customer interactions every day.

As enterprises increasingly adopt AI-first customer engagement solutions, Exotel is at the forefront of delivering highly scalable, secure and enterprise-grade deployments across Contact Centre, CPaaS and Conversational AI.

Location: Bangalore or Gurgaon

About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of complex enterprise implementations across Exotel s Customer Engagement portfolio. You will operate as the single-threaded owner for customer deployments, driving projects from kickoff through production go-live, hypercare and operational handover.

This is not a traditional project management role. You will be responsible for ensuring successful delivery of technically complex, integration-heavy implementations while maintaining governance across timelines, scope, risks, commercial milestones and customer expectations.

Working closely with customers and cross-functional teams-including Sales, Pre-Sales, Solution Architecture, Product, Engineering, Support, Customer Success and Finance-you will ensure every deployment is delivered on time, within scope and to the highest quality standards.

The ideal candidate combines strong project management discipline with technical aptitude, thrives in ambiguous environments, and has a proven ability to drive execution across multiple enterprise projects simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities Program Project Governance
  • Own the complete project lifecycle for multiple concurrent enterprise implementations from project initiation through production handover.
  • Build and maintain detailed project plans, milestones, RAID logs, dependency trackers and governance dashboards.
  • Define and enforce stage gates and entry/exit criteria across Kickoff, Solution Design, Development, UAT, Go-Live, Hypercare and Handover.
  • Drive regular governance reviews and provide accurate project health updates to customer and executive stakeholders.

End-to-End Delivery Execution
  • Lead enterprise implementations across Contact Centre, Voice, Conversational AI and customer engagement solutions.
  • Drive execution against committed timelines while balancing scope, quality and customer expectations.
  • Coordinate implementation activities across internal teams and external customer stakeholders to ensure timely project delivery.
  • Ensure all commercial, technical and operational milestones are achieved before project closure.
Customer Stakeholder Management
  • Act as the primary customer-facing delivery lead throughout the implementation lifecycle.
  • Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers and manage communication across business and technical stakeholders.
  • Lead project governance meetings, steering committees, technical workshops and executive status reviews.
  • Communicate risks, dependencies and delivery updates with clarity and confidence.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Collaborate closely with Solution Architects, Engineering and Product teams to translate customer requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Coordinate activities across Sales, Customer Success, Support and Finance to ensure smooth project execution.
  • Build solution documentation, Low-Level Designs (LLDs), implementation plans and Scope of Work (SOW) documents.
  • Drive alignment across teams to resolve blockers and accelerate project delivery.

Technical Delivery Enterprise Readiness
  • Coordinate complex enterprise integrations involving REST APIs, Webhooks, CRM platforms (Salesforce, Zendesk, Freshdesk), authentication systems, databases and third-party applications.
  • Manage enterprise deployment requirements including maintenance windows, change management processes and production readiness.
  • Coordinate customer Information Security reviews, compliance questionnaires, architecture reviews and deployment approvals.
  • Ensure customer environments are fully prepared for successful production deployments.

Risk, Scope Escalation Management
  • Proactively identify project risks, technical challenges and execution bottlenecks before they impact delivery.
  • Manage project scope through structured change management and prevent uncontrolled scope creep.
  • Drive timely resolution of customer and internal escalations through effective stakeholder management.
  • Maintain clear visibility into dependencies and ensure mitigation plans are actively tracked.

UAT, Go-Live, Hypercare Handover
  • Own User Acceptance Testing (UAT) planning, execution and customer sign-offs.
  • Coordinate production readiness assessments and Go-Live activities.
  • Lead post-production hypercare until solution stabilisation.
  • Ensure seamless transition to Customer Success and Support teams with complete operational documentation.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 6-8 years of experience in Technical Project Management, Program Management or Enterprise Delivery.
  • Proven experience delivering customer-facing enterprise software implementations in SaaS, CPaaS, CCaaS, Telecom or Cloud technology environments.
  • Strong track record of managing multiple concurrent enterprise deployments.

Technical Knowledge

  • Good understanding of enterprise software implementations involving APIs, REST integrations, Webhooks and cloud-based applications.
  • Working knowledge of Linux, networking fundamentals and SIP-based telephony is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with Voice infrastructure, RTP streams, codecs and enterprise communication platforms is a plus.
  • Exposure to enterprise Information Security processes, SOC 2, architecture reviews and data privacy standards is desirable.

Project Management

  • Strong experience managing project plans, RAID logs, dependency tracking and governance frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, Salesforce or similar project management tools.
  • Ability to execute projects using Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery methodologies depending on customer requirements.

Leadership Communication

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder management, negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive outcomes in ambiguous, fast-paced and cross-functional environments.
  • High ownership, accountability and bias for execution.

Job Title : Senior Product Manager

Location : Bangalore; (Full Time, Onsite)

About Locus

Battle-tested in 350+ deployments across 30+ countries, Locus is an agentic Transportation Management System for all-mile, all-channel, trusted by enterprises like Unilever, Nestl , and Siam Makro.

The platform unifies orders, capacity, and carrier networks into one living plan, aligning planning, execution, and settlement so promises become proof. AI co-pilots with guardrails surface risk early and recommend the next best move to protect SLAs and reduce empty miles.

In 2025, Locus joined the Ingka Group (IKEA Retail) family, marking a major milestone in our journey. Backed by the scale and strength of IKEA, we continue to operate independently while accelerating our mission to make global supply chains faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

Our Journey and Impact

Since 2015, Locus has been on a mission to make logistics decision-making intelligent, sustainable, and real-world ready. Our platform has powered billions of deliveries across 30 + countries for global enterprises, driving measurable impact in cost savings, carbon reduction, and SLA performance. With the strength of the IKEA ecosystem behind us, we re scaling that impact even further.

Our Global Footprint

Headquartered in Bangalore, with teams across the U.S., U.K., UAE, and Southeast Asia, Locus brings together 170 + engineers, designers, and problem-solvers united by a single goal: to reinvent how the world moves goods.

Traits We Value

We look for people who are:

  • Global in mindset : curious about diverse markets and ideas.

  • Unrelenting in drive : energized by complex challenges.

  • Intelligent in approach : analytical, creative, and thoughtful.

  • Dynamic in execution : adaptive and decisive in fast-moving contexts.

  • Exact in craft : detail-oriented and committed to excellence.

About the role

Locus is rebuilding last-mile delivery as a multi-tenant SaaS platform. The DiSCO Mobile App is the driver-facing surface - used by drivers, 2-person crews, and hub-ops staff across enterprise tenants (IKEA, Giant Tiger, and the long tail of Locus customers).

The Senior PM will own one or more product modules end-to-end - Hub Depot Operations, Execution at Customer Stop, Returns Reverse Logistics, Multi-Trip Shifts, or Workforce Auth - from scoping with domain PMs, through workflow design with UX, to release readiness with the engineering pod and customer-onboarding teams.

The role partners with the Principal PM on overall app vision and runs its modules independently.


What youll do

  • Own a slice of the mobile app: scope it, write the spec, drive design partnership, shepherd it through engineering, land it in tenant rollouts.

  • Author mobile workflow specs (Delivery / Pickup / Hub Depot / Returns) and the matching epic + story tickets in Jira.

  • Coordinate with domain PMs (Execution, Hub Ops, Workforce, Order Management) to translate entity specs and design decisions into driver-facing scenarios.

  • Partner with UX on gap closure and with the mobile engineering pod on sequencing and delivery.

  • Own one or more enterprise tenant rollouts - translating customer requirements into product changes vs. tenant config, and holding the line on what is product-grade vs. one-off.

  • Uphold platform defaults: client-agnostic architecture, point-of-use permissions, plain-language UX, no over-engineered enterprise theatre.

What were looking for

  • 6+ years in product management, including 3+ years on enterprise SaaS or platform products. Mobile app PM experience is a strong plus.

  • Shipped in domain-heavy, multi-team environments - comfortable reading entity specs, sequence diagrams, and engineering RFCs, not just user stories.

  • Spec author. Can write a 3,000-word workflow doc that engineering, design, and customer success can all build from.

  • Strong opinions about driver / operator UX - has shipped for low-context, high-pressure mobile users (delivery, field service, frontline ops, warehousing).

  • Jira-as-source-of-truth discipline: every scope decision is a ticket, every blocker is a link, every spec gap is a child story.

  • Bias toward plain language, concrete examples, and decision-by-tradeoff over decision-by-framework.

Nice to have

  • Logistics / last-mile / supply-chain domain background.

  • Multi-tenant SaaS scoping experience (whats product vs. whats tenant config).

  • Comfort with domain-driven teams (DDD, event sourcing, entity-first specs


What We Offer

Join Locus and become part of a visionary team that is redefining logistics through innovation and smart distribution. We provide competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative environment where your expertise will drive both your growth and that of the organization.

Locus is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace.

jobDescription:
Red Nucleus is hiring a Agile Project Manager - iTakeControl to join our global team. This role will be fully onsite at our Pune office. There may be flexibility to transition to a hybrid work model in the future, based on business requirements.


Our purpose is advancing knowledge to improve lives. We succeed by being the premier provider of strategic learning and development, scientific advisory services, and medical communications solutions for the life sciences industry. Our global team is composed of nearly 800 full-time employees whose commitment to creativity, quality, and on-time delivery is unrivaled in our space.


At Red Nucleus, we believe in providing a rich working environment that pushes us to innovate in ways that engages our employees to be their best selves. Our culture is about meaningful work, a true sense of community, and fun. We love to celebrate our people and we are proud to have been Internationally recognized as a Great Place to Work".


How You Will Contribute

In this position, you will be working with our Clinical Research team. For more information, please visit ITC I Red Nucleus.

Job Overview

iTakeControl is a clinical trial platform supporting live studies within a validated, GxP-compliant environment. We are bringing the platform fully in-house and building the team that will own and grow it.


We are looking for an experienced Agile Project Manager to own delivery and be the bridge between the business and the engineering team. You will balance two priorities: coordinating the delivery of the platform to clients including configuring and launching new clinical studies and driving the ongoing development of the product. The immediate focus is keeping client delivery running smoothly; as that settles into a steady cadence, the role grows to take on more of the process governance-Agile principles, Scrum practices, and continuous improvement.


This is a delivery-accountable role for someone who can translate between business and technical teams, keep priorities clear, and make sure the right work ships at the right time. It works closely with US-based stakeholders and requires daily overlap with US hours.

What Youll Own

  • Client delivery own the end-to-end delivery and configuration of the platform for clients, getting new studies live and supported on time and within compliance
  • Product delivery own the teams delivery rhythm: prioritization, planning, and release coordination for the core platform in collaboration with the Product management team
  • The bridge intake the feature requirements, enhancement requests from product team and create the realistic development plan in collaboration with the engineering team, and keep both sides aligned on what comes first and why
  • Priority calls make and communicate the trade-offs when client delivery and product work compete for the same people
  • Delivery health track and report progress using meaningful flow metrics, and surface risks early with options
  • Process efficiency - As the engineering team matures, build efficiency KPIs for teams delivery and quality performance.

You will partner closely with the Technical Lead, who owns technical direction; this role owns coordination and delivery.


What Were Looking For

Experience and Mindset

  • 7+ years managing software delivery, with a strong track record of shipping on time
  • Proven experience owning client-facing delivery or implementation not only internal product work
  • Strong agile background, with the judgement to choose and adapt the right approach for the team rather than applying one framework by rote (we are not tied to a single methodology)
  • Comfortable managing multiple concurrent priorities and competing deadlines
  • A natural translator between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, who can negotiate realistic plans between the two
  • Strong ownership instincts accountable for outcomes, not just facilitation
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills builds trust quickly across clients, leadership, and the engineering team, and keeps everyone informed and aligned
  • Stays composed under pressure keeps a clear head and a steady hand when priorities collide, deadlines tighten, or issues escalate, and brings the team along calmly
  • Clear, honest communicator who brings problems forward early

Clinical and Regulatory

  • Life sciences background is essential experience delivering software in clinical trials, healthcare IT, pharma, medical devices, or an equivalent regulated environment
  • Understanding of what it means to deliver within a validated, GxP-compliant system change control, data integrity, and the discipline a regulated environment demands

Technical Fluency

  • Enough technical fluency to coordinate engineering work credibly understand dependencies, ask the right questions, and challenge estimates (you do not need to write code)
  • Comfortable with standard delivery and collaboration tooling, and open to AI-assisted tools that speed up planning and reporting

Education and Experience



  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences, or a related field
  • 7+ years in software project / delivery management, including client-facing delivery and/or Scrum Master roles
  • 3+ years leading delivery for an engineering team
  • 3+ years within regulated or validated software environments (clinical, GxP, FDA, HIPAA, or equivalent)
  • Strong understanding of Agile frameworks including Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe.
  • Agile and/or project management certification (CSM, PSM, PMI-ACP, SAFe, PMP, or equivalent) a plus

title: Technical Lead
jobDescription:
Job Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Technical Lead to own the technical design and delivery of client-facing and internal modules across .NET, modern JavaScript frontends, and cloud. You will turn functional requirements into designs that are secure, scalable, and maintainable and then build a substantial part of them yourself.

This is a coding role first and a leadership role second. Expect to spend the majority of your time in the codebase: writing the hard parts, reviewing pull requests, unblocking your team, and holding the quality line. You will work closely with the Solution Architect and delivery leadership on the wider architecture, and you will be the person who makes sure it actually lands in production the way it was designed.

You will also be hands-on in how we adopt AI/ML and LLM-based capabilities across our delivery portfolio.


Key Responsibilities


Technical Design & Delivery

  • Own the technical design of assigned modules and applications application logic, integration points, data model, and deployment approach.
  • Translate functional requirements and user stories into technical designs, sequence diagrams, API contracts, and data models.
  • Contribute to solution-level architecture decisions and document trade-offs for the options considered and rejected.
  • Break down features into tasks, estimate effort realistically, and drive them to completion within sprint commitments.
  • Design with non-functional requirements in mind from the start: performance, scalability, security, observability, and cost.
  • Execute staged modernisation of legacy applications (e.g., .NET Framework / .NET Core current LTS) under an agreed migration plan.
  • Apply and enforce engineering standards: coding guidelines, branching strategy, code review expectations, test coverage, and definition of done.

Hands-On Engineering

  • Write production code for the complex, high-risk, or performance-critical parts of the system.
  • Build proofs of concept, reference implementations, and reusable components for the team.
  • Review pull requests with substance correctness, security, performance, and readability, not just style.
  • Diagnose production issues: performance bottlenecks, memory pressure, N+1 queries, cache behaviour, and concurrency problems.
  • Keep CI/CD, automated testing, and quality gates working and taken seriously by the team.

Cloud & Platform

  • Build and operate solutions on Azure or AWS compute, storage, networking, identity, and secrets management.
  • Implement containerisation and deployment pipelines where appropriate (Docker, and Kubernetes/AKS/EKS where in use).
  • Instrument applications for observability logging, metrics, tracing, alerting and act on what they show.
  • Flag cost implications of design choices and implement agreed optimisations.

AI/ML & LLM Solutions

  • Build LLM-backed features: RAG pipelines, chunking and embedding strategy, vector store integration, retrieval quality, and prompt and context design.
  • Understand the practical trade-offs between prompt engineering, RAG, and fine-tuning, and pick sensibly for the problem at hand.
  • Handle the real constraints of LLM systems: latency, token cost, rate limits, caching, fallback behaviour, and graceful degradation.
  • Implement evaluation and guardrails groundedness checks, hallucination mitigation, PII handling, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
  • Have an informed view on where AI/ML genuinely adds value and where it does not.
  • Work with data engineering on the pipelines and data quality these features depend on.

Team Leadership & Mentoring

  • Lead a team of 38 engineers day to day: task allocation, standups, unblocking, and progress visibility.
  • Mentor mid-level and junior engineers through code review, pairing, and design discussions.
  • Own the technical quality of what your team ships, including defect triage and release readiness.
  • Support technical hiring interviewing and candidate evaluation.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, tech talks, and reusable IP.

Client & Delivery Support

  • Join technical discussions and requirement clarification sessions with clients where needed.
  • Provide effort estimates and technical inputs for proposals and solution approach documents.
  • Explain technical decisions and trade-offs clearly to project managers, clients, and stakeholders.

Required Skills


Must Have Depth Expected

  • 69 years in software engineering, with production systems you have personally built and shipped.
  • Strong .NET / C# ASP.NET Core, Web API, Entity Framework Core, async programming, dependency injection, and current LTS versions.
  • Solid working experience with one cloud platform Azure or AWS. Azure preferred (App Service, Functions, Azure SQL / PostgreSQL, Service Bus, Key Vault, Entra ID, Application Insights). AWS equivalents equally acceptable.
  • At least one modern frontend framework in depth Angular or React plus TypeScript. Working familiarity with the other is a plus.
  • Node.js for services, tooling, or BFF layers.
  • Databases: strong SQL (SQL Server / PostgreSQL), data modelling, indexing, and query tuning. Awareness of NoSQL and when it fits.
  • Design and architectural patterns: REST API design, layered/clean architecture, messaging and queues, caching strategies, and a working understanding of microservices and event-driven design including when a monolith is the better answer.
  • Security fundamentals: OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, RBAC, secrets management, OWASP Top 10.
  • DevOps: Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, Git branching strategies, Docker.

Must Have Working Understanding

  • Practical understanding of AI/ML concepts and the ML lifecycle.
  • Hands-on exposure to LLM-based application development RAG, embeddings, vector databases (pgvector, Azure AI Search, Pinecone, or similar), and orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with major model providers and the trade-offs between hosted APIs and self-hosted/open models.
  • Python for AI/ML, scripting, and data work.
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code (Bicep/ARM/Terraform).

Non-Technical

  • Clear written communication your design notes and PR comments matter as much as your code.
  • Ability to explain a technical trade-off to a project manager and to a junior engineer, on the same day, without changing your answer.
  • Comfortable being challenged and equally comfortable changing your mind when the argument is better.
  • Ownership: you follow a decision through to production, not to the end of the design phase.

Qualification

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Master's is a plus.
  • Equivalent demonstrable experience will be considered in place of formal qualifications.

Preferred (Added Advantage)

  • Cloud certification Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204), Azure Administrator (AZ-104), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or the AWS equivalents.
  • Experience in an IT services or consulting environment with multiple concurrent clients.
  • Exposure to data engineering and analytics Azure Synapse, Databricks, PySpark, dbt, Power BI.
  • Experience running containerised workloads in production.
  • Experience shipping an AI/LLM feature to production, including how it was evaluated.
  • Open-source contributions, technical writing, or conference speaking.

What Success Looks Like in This Role


First 90 days

  • Productive in the codebase and reviewing pull requests independently.
  • Understood the module landscape you own and identified its top technical risks with evidence.
  • Delivered at least one design document and one feature shipped end to end.

First 6–12 months

  • Engineering standards consistently followed by your team, with review and test discipline visibly improved.
  • Measurable improvement in delivery predictability, defect escape rate, or system performance.
  • At least one AI/LLM capability built, evaluated, and delivered to production or a credible pilot.
  • One or more engineers visibly levelled up under your mentorship.

What We Offer

  • Real ownership of the technical design and delivery of the systems you work on.
  • Direct access to leadership and a short path from decision to implementation.
  • Room to grow into a Solution Architect role, with the support to get there.
  • Hands-on work on modern cloud and AI engineering, not maintenance.
  • Sponsorship for certifications and continuous learning.
  • A collaborative, engineering-led environment.

How to Apply

Share your CV at [careers email] with the subject line "Application – Technical Lead – Pune". Include a brief note on one technical decision you made that turned out to be wrong, and what you did about it.

Agents

not in the business of rebuilding what a major cloud vendor will productise in six months
RAG, Knowledge & Graph
• Design and implement end-to-end RAG architectures ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval,
reranking
• Select and manage vector databases appropriate to the use case
• Build knowledge pipelines that turn unstructured client data into queryable intelligence
• Apply knowledge graph structures (e.g. Neo4j) where relational or semantic reasoning adds value
beyond flat vector retrieval
Evaluation & Observability
• Design and own eval frameworks; automated evals, LLM-as-a-Judge, task-completion harnesses
• Define what 'working correctly' looks like for each agent and measure it continuously in production
• Instrument agents for cost, latency, and quality
Platform & Collaboration
• Contribute to platform standards how agents are built, deployed, monitored, and governed
• Ensure agents are production-grade: observable, cost-aware, GDPR and EU AI Act compliant
• Work with engineering, business stakeholders, and the Director of Platform, Engineering & AI to
translate process problems into agentic solutions
What We're Looking For
Must-Have
• Production experience building and deploying agentic AI systems not just prototypes
• Strong Python engineering: clean, tested, maintainable code
• Hands-on RAG pipeline design chunking strategies, embedding models, retrieval, evaluation
• Production experience with at least one vector database
• LLM evaluation experience automated evals, LLM-as-a-Judge, or equivalent agent accuracy
measurement
• Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar) and the
judgement to know when not to use them
• Solid LLM fundamentals: prompting, tool calling, structured outputs, context management
• Cloud infrastructure comfort GCP preferred; strong AWS/Azure considered
Nice-to-Have
• Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or Vertex AI Agent Builder
• MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent-to-agent communication patterns
• Knowledge graphs or graph databases (Neo4j, JanusGraph) in retrieval or reasoning contexts
• LLMOps / observability tooling LangSmith, Langfuse, or equivalent

• Background in BPO, AP automation, or document processing workflows

• Shipped agents, not demos production deployment matters more than framework familiarity
• Engineering mindset you care about reliability, cost, testability, and observability
• Built evals, not vibes you measure whether agents work and instrument from day one
• Build-vs-buy judgment you reach for GCP-native and enterprise tooling before writing custom
infrastructure you've seen bespoke orchestration layers made redundant by a platform release, and
you build accordingly
• Comfortable with ambiguity you help define the patterns rather than follow them
• Business curious you want to understand the process you're automating, not just the stack
A Note on This Role
Agentic AI engineering is genuinely new. We don't expect 10 years of experience in a discipline that's 2 years
old. What we do expect is evidence of building real things, strong software engineering foundations, and the
intellectual curiosity to stay ahead of a fast-moving field. If you've been doing this seriously for 18 months and
have production systems to show for it, we want to hear from you.

jobDescription:
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated SoC Performance Modeling & Architecture Engineer to drive the definition, analysis, and optimization of our next-generation Systems-on-Chip (SoCs). In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end performance lifecycle from workload analysis and microarchitectural modeling to post-silicon correlation. You will evaluate complex architectural trade-offs across CPU, GPU, NPU/ML accelerators, Memory, and Network-on-Chip (NoC) subsystems to maximize performance-per-watt and shape the roadmap for future silicon.
Key Responsibilities
1. Performance Modeling & Simulation
  • Leverage and Maintain Cycle-Approximate Models: Leverage, and maintain execution-driven and trace-driven SoC performance simulators (e.g., using C++, SystemC, or Python).
  • Explore Architectural Space: Construct scalable models to project the performance of future SoC configurations and validate architectural concepts before RTL freeze.
  • Hardware/Software Co-Design: Model the interaction between hardware subsystems and low-level software stacks to identify system-wide bottlenecks.
2. Workload Analysis & Benchmarking
  • Characterize Workloads: Profile and analyze industry-standard benchmarks and real-world use cases across CPU (e.g., SPEC CPU), GPU (e.g., 3DMark, GFXBench), and Machine Learning/AI (e.g., MLPerf, LLM inference, CNNs).
  • Trace Generation: Capture and manipulate instruction and memory traces from both pre-silicon environments and post-silicon hardware.
3. Subsystem & Interconnect Analysis
  • NoC & Fabric Optimization: Evaluate Network-on-Chip (NoC) topologies, routing algorithms, arbitration schemes, and bandwidth/latency characteristics under heavy multi-master workloads.
  • Memory Hierarchy Evaluation: Analyze the impact of cache hierarchies (L1/L2/System Cache), memory controllers, and various memory technologies (e.g., LPDDR5/6, HBM) on system performance.
4. PPA (Power, Performance, Area) Trade-off Studies
  • Multi-Domain Trade-offs: Evaluate complex trade-offs when scaling or configuring different combinations of CPU cores, GPU compute units, and ML accelerators.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Technical Expertise
  • Education: BS/MS in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of industry experience in SoC/Processor architecture and performance modeling.
  • Programming: Strong proficiency in C/ C++ and Python
  • Architecture Knowledge: Deep understanding of modern computer architecture, including pipelining, out-of-order execution, cache coherence protocols, and virtual memory.
  • Modeling Frameworks: Direct experience with performance modeling frameworks (e.g., gem5, SystemC, or proprietary cycle-accurate / cycle-approximate simulators).
Preferred Qualifications
  • Hands-on experience with post-silicon debug tools and reading hardware performance counters (e.g., ARM PMU, Intel VTune, or internal test chips).
  • Familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and compiling/mapping models to specialized hardware accelerators.
  • Experience utilizing data visualization tools to present complex performance metrics cleanly to cross-functional stakeholders.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Frontend AI Platform
jobDescription:
The Role
We are currently seeking a Senior Frontend Software Engineer to join the AI Platform team , Addepar s next-generation AI platform that enables seamless insights and interaction through natural language and data intelligence across our AI products.

As a Senior Frontend Engineer , you ll design and scale the interactive surface of AI Platform products. You ll work at the intersection of AI, design, and systems engineering, building a class of real-time AI experiences for users where every frame, token, and scroll behavior matters.
You will collaborate closely with product design, backend, and AI/ML engineers to deliver smooth, trustworthy AI experiences that align with Addepar s standards of performance, transparency, and reliability.
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

What You ll Do
  • Design and implement complex, real-time UI features for conversational interfaces including chat streaming, incremental rendering, and dynamic layouts.
  • Build high-performance WebSocket pipelines to handle streamed deltas, retries, and backpressure gracefully.
  • Optimize scrolling and rendering performance using requestAnimationFrame, virtualization, intersection observers, and non-blocking state updates.
  • Implement fault-tolerant UI logic for reconnection, cancellation, offline recovery, and retry without user disruption.
  • Architect state management and caching strategies to maintain consistency between local UI and backend deltas.
  • Collaborate with designers to deliver accessible, responsive, and pixel-perfect interfaces across themes and viewport sizes.
  • Extend Addepar s frontend developer experience refine the build pipeline (Vite/Webpack), test automation (Playwright, Jest), and linting/formatting standards (ESLint, Prettier).
  • Instrument client-side telemetry and performance metrics to measure render latency, streaming lag, and user interaction speed.
  • Mentor teammates through design reviews and pair programming, contributing to shared components and cross-product standards.
  • Work closely with backend and AI/ML teams to co-design message formats, token streaming APIs, and session-level resiliency mechanisms.
  • Shape the technical direction of AI Platform s frontend, contributing to shared libraries, caching strategies.
Technical Fundamentals & Practices -
We re looking for engineers who demonstrate mastery across the following practices and system fundamentals that empower to ship high-quality, low-latency conversational experiences at scale:
Browser & Rendering Fundamentals :
    • Deep understanding of the browser s rendering pipeline DOM, CSSOM, layout, paint, compositing.
    • Ability to identify and fix layout thrashing, paint storms, and jank through Chrome DevTools performance profiling.
    • Knowledge of animation scheduling via requestAnimationFrame, idle callbacks, and microtask queues.Familiarity with modern web APIs such as IntersectionObserver, ResizeObserver, MutationObserver, OffscreenCanvas, Web Workers, and BroadcastChannel for concurrent or cross-tab coordination.
Asynchronous & Streaming Systems:
    • Strong command of Promises, async/await, generators, and cancellation (AbortController).
    • Familiarity with streaming data protocols (e.g., WebSockets, SSE) and patterns like batching, throttling, and debounce under load.
    • Understanding of backpressure and how to pace UI rendering vs. message ingress.
State & Data Synchronization:
    • Experience designing immutable data flows with fine-grained updates (diffs, patches, deltas).
    • Knowledge of caching, reconciliation, and hash-based change detection (e.g., djb2, CRC32, content hashing).
    • Practices for ensuring consistency between transient client state and authoritative backend models.
UI Architecture & Composition:
    • Familiarity with reactive component frameworks (Svelte preferred; React/Vue acceptable).
    • Experience isolating side effects, using stores/signals, and maintaining predictable reactivity graphs.
    • Ability to decompose large applications into feature modules with lazy loading, error boundaries, and shared design tokens.
    • Ability to evaluate and integrate across frameworks (Svelte, React, Web Components) while maintaining consistent patterns in state, testing, and accessibility.
Performance & Profiling:
    • Proven skill in measuring and optimizing UI latency (first paint, input delay, FPS stability).
    • Comfort with Chrome Performance, Lighthouse, or custom performance markers.Experience building virtualized views (infinite scroll, chat lists, large tables).
Design Systems & Accessibility:
    • Experience building and maintaining reusable design systems with Storybook, Tailwind, or Web Components.Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG, ARIA) and best practices for keyboard, color, and screen reader support.Skilled at collaborating with design teams to translate high-fidelity Figma specs into performant, production-ready components.
Resilience, Testing & Observability:
    • Writes defensive code to handle partial data, dropped connections, race conditions, and AbortErrors.
    • Understands test pyramids: unit, integration, and end-to-end (Playwright, Jest, Vitest).
    • Adds telemetry hooks and log events to diagnose production issues and user experience regressions.
Developer Experience & Tooling:
    • Comfortable configuring bundlers (Vite, Webpack) and optimizing build times.
    • Sets up linting, type checking, and pre-commit automation for consistency.
    • Experience with CI/CD, incremental testing, and feature flag rollouts.
    • Experience with AI-assisted developer tools or scripting build/test automation to improve team velocity.
Mindset:
    • You think in systems, not pages.
    • You balance aesthetics with performance, correctness, and maintainability. You obsess over the invisible details micro-interactions, latency, and flow that make complex products feel effortless.
    • You enjoy teaching others, debugging difficult issues, and making the team move faster through better abstractions.
Who You Are
  • Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • At least 5 years of professional frontend development experience in a production environment.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and deep understanding of asynchronous browser behavior .
  • Experience with Svelte , React , or another component-based modern UI framework.
  • Strong debugging and performance profiling skills.
  • Experience integrating real-time or streaming data into user interfaces.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.
  • Additional certifications or licenses
  • Skills and competencies that also include soft skills necessary for success
  • Bonus: Familiarity with AI/LLM-powered interfaces , progressive streaming UIs , or data-rich visualization frameworks .
  • You care deeply about user experience, developer productivity, and measurable performance and you know that excellence in frontend engineering is achieved through curiosity, rigor, and empathy for both users and teammates.

title: Lead Engineer - AI
jobDescription:
Position Overview
We re hiring an AI Lead Engineer to architect, ship, and scale production-grade Computer Vision with a focused GenAI charter. You ll lead 6 10 ML/CV engineers to deliver high-accuracy, low-latency video analytics detection, tracking, segmentation, recognition, re-identification tackling multi-camera tracking, 24/7 streaming at scale, long-tail drift, and edge optimization on GPUs/Jetson, while partnering with Product/Platform to meet FPS, latency, accuracy, and cost SLAs. The day-to-day centers on core CV model design, training/leval, deployment, and streaming/edge performance, complemented by GenAI that amplifies the stack: integrating VLM/LLM capabilities for natural-language video search, incident summarization, operator Q&A, and copilot workflows; standing up RAG over video/sensor/metadata embeddings with robust prompts, tooling, evals, and guardrails; and driving data ops with synthetic data, auto-labeling, active-learning triage with privacy, safety, and cost controls.

What You ll Own:
  • End-to-end delivery of CV products : problem framing data/labeling model design optimization deployment monitoring iteration.

  • Technical roadmap & architecture for video analytics pipelines (ingest decode infer track post-process store/serve).

  • Team leadership : mentoring, hiring input, OKRs, code/research standards, and performance coaching.

Key Responsibilities: Technical Leadership & Execution
  • Translate business goals (e.g., reduce shrinkage, increase throughput, improve safety ) into measurable CV objectives and SLAs/SLOs (e.g., mAP/IDF1, per-frame latency, dropped-frame rate, cost/stream).

  • Lead design reviews; establish MLOps and coding standards; enforce experiment tracking, reproducibility , and dataset/version governance.

  • Drive capacity planning , GPU/Jetson utilization, batching/windowing strategy, autoscaling, and cost governance.

Computer Vision R&D (Detection, Tracking, Segmentation, Recognition)
  • Deliver production models for object detection / segmentation / classification / tracking (e.g., YOLOv8/v9, Mask R-CNN/Mask2Former, EfficientNet/ConvNeXt, ByteTrack/OC-SORT/DeepSORT ).

  • Build person/vehicle/product re-ID , face/attribute recognition (e.g., ArcFace/CosFace), OCR (e.g., PP-OCR), and keypoint/action recognition (e.g., MMPose, SlowFast/X3D).

  • Tackle domain adaptation, class imbalance, and occlusions; design augmentations and semi-supervised/active learning loops to harvest hard negatives.

Video Analytics & Edge Inference
  • Architect real-time pipelines using NVIDIA DeepStream/GStreamer/OpenCV ; optimize decode (NVDEC), pre/post, and trackers for 30 60 FPS at 1080p .

  • Optimize with TensorRT/ONNX Runtime/Torch-TensorRT , INT8 calibration, pruning/distillation; leverage Jetson Orin/Xavier/Nano and DLA where applicable.

  • Design multi-camera fusion , homography/camera calibration, and cross-camera ID consistency for retail, traffic, manufacturing, and security use cases.

  • Implement privacy-by-design features (e.g., face/license blur , PII redaction).

Generative AI & LLMs

  • Architect robust RAG: retrieval pipelines with Pinecone/ChromaDB/Milvus; index sharding/compaction; freshness policies; hybrid search.

  • Design agents with LangChain/LangGraph; implement tool-use, safety filters, and guardrails; add evaluation loops (e.g., RAGAS/DeepEval-style).

Platform, Serving & MLOps
  • Ship services via FastAPI/Flask ; containerize with Docker ; orchestrate on Kubernetes (KServe) or AWS SageMaker/Vertex AI .

  • Build high-throughput inference with Triton Inference Server (dynamic batching, concurrent models, model ensembles).

  • Streaming & storage: RTSP/RTMP ingest , Kafka/Kinesis, object storage + time-series DB; index/frame-level metadata for search and analytics.

  • CI/CD with MLflow/DVC (artifacts, model registry), unit/integration tests, and rollout strategies (canary, shadow).

Observability, Drift & Governance
  • Production monitoring with Prometheus/Grafana ; per-stage latency, FPS, GPU memory/SM occupancy, dropped frames , and backpressure.

  • Model observability: data/feature drift, concept drift on detections/tracks, re-ID distribution shifts, outlier/novelty detection, safety metrics.

  • Human-in-the-loop review tools (CVAT/Label Studio) and auto-retraining triggers ; maintain model cards, evaluation reports, versioned prompts/configs, and auditability.

  • Ensure compliance and privacy/PII handling; ONVIF/edge security best practices.

Cross-Functional & People Leadership
  • Partner with Product/SRE/DevOps on roadmaps, SLAs, incident response runbooks , and cost/perf tradeoffs.

  • Lead and grow a 6 10 person CV team; foster a culture of high-quality experiments, rigorous reviews, and measurable impact.

  • Communicate progress/risks to executives with clear, metric-driven updates and customer-facing results.

Required Qualifications
  • Candidate shall have a degree in B.E/B.Tech/MCA in any discipline preferable computer science
  • 5 8 years in ML/Computer Vision with 2+ years leading 6 10 engineers delivering production video analytics.
  • Proven track record shipping detection / tracking / segmentation / recognition systems with business impact (accuracy, latency, cost).
Strong in at least one per category (and comfortable across most) :
  • CV Frameworks: PyTorch (preferred) or TensorFlow; OpenCV, NVIDIA DeepStream/GStreamer.
  • Serving/Runtime: Triton Inference Server, FastAPI/Flask.
  • Optimization: TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, Torch-TensorRT; quantization / pruning / distillation; INT8 calibration.
  • Tracking/Re-ID/OCR: ByteTrack/OC-SORT/DeepSORT; ArcFace/CosFace; PP-OCR/Tesseract.
  • Agents & Retrieval: LangChain or LangGraph; Pinecone/ChromaDB/Milvus
  • MLOps: Docker, Kubernetes (KServe/SageMaker/Vertex AI), MLflow/DVC.
  • Cloud: AWS (SageMaker, EC2/EKS) or GCP (Vertex AI) or Azure ML (AKS).
  • Programming: Python (expert); C++ or Go for perf-critical components; CUDA fundamentals a plus.
  • Streaming/IO: RTSP/RTMP, Kafka/Kinesis/Rabbitmq; ONVIF familiarity.
  • Strong system design (multi-stream pipelines, GPU scheduling, distributed tracking/indexing) and excellent communication.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Operating vector or time-series stores for video metadata at 10M 50M+ rows; search over tracks, IDs, and events.
  • Experience with multi-camera tracking , calibration and zone-based analytics.
  • Jetson fleet management.
  • Ray/Ray Serve or Kubeflow ; feature stores (Feast); complex event processing.
  • Domain experience in one or more: retail analytics , traffic/ADAS , manufacturing QA , security/safety , sports analytics .
  • Open-source contributions, patents, or publications in CV/video analytics.

Role Summary As a Level-2 (L2) Application Support Engineer, you are the first line of functional support for Solverminds LRP maritime-ERP application, owning the resolution of functional and configuration issues for our liner-shipping clients. You sit between first-level (L1) contact and the technical / L3 team - resolving what can be handled at the functional layer within agreed SLAs, and escalating only genuine code, bug or data-level fixes, with a clear diagnosis. Where the client engagement is a dedicated 24x7 support desk, the role works on a rotational shift basis.

Role Responsibilities

  • Act as the first line of functional support for the assigned vertical, minimising escalation of queries to developers.
  • Own all tickets raised in JIRA end-to-end - provide first-level functional resolution and manage each tickets lifecycle, prioritisation, status and customer communication within SLA.
  • Reproduce, diagnose and resolve functional and configuration issues; escalate to technical / L3 only items that need bug fixing, code changes or production data-level fixes - with full context and the steps already tried.
  • Meet agreed response and resolution SLAs; flag at-risk tickets early and follow the escalation procedure strictly.
  • Document, manage and share critical application and industry knowledge - troubleshooting steps, SOPs, FAQs and knowledge-base articles - to drive first-time-fix and ticket deflection.
  • Use the available support and AI knowledge tools (e.g. the LRP support assistant) to speed diagnosis and guide users.
  • Continuously assess product and training gaps in the allocated vertical and provide structured feedback for improvement.
  • Collaborate with the Training team to close documentation gaps; review ticket trends and recommend training and root-cause actions.
  • Participate actively in rotational cross-training for comprehensive functional (and basic technical) coverage.
  • Where the engagement is 24x7, work a rotational shift pattern with clean shift handovers.

Requirements

  • Proficiency in English, with excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Bachelors degree in a related field is preferred.
  • 5+ preferred in application / functional support, ideally as a super-user of a liner or maritime application.
  • Working knowledge of the full liner business cycle, or clear command of at least one vertical workflow to explain / train.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices (incident, problem, request) and knowledge management; experience working to SLAs.
  • Experience with ERP systems; JIRA or an equivalent ticketing tool is a must.
  • Basic SQL / data-investigation ability is an advantage for faster diagnosis.
  • Ability to prepare reports and present the case to customers.
  • Ability to give and accept critical feedback for self-improvement.
  • Consistent work track record (no frequent job changes).
  • Expert knowledge of Liner Ship Management is advantageous.

Preferred Experience

  • Prior involvement with the LRP application.
  • Hands-on experience as a functional expert.
  • Knowledge of shipping processes and industry-specific software applications.
  • Experience supporting users from diverse cultural backgrounds.
  • Experience in a dedicated and / or 24x7 client-support model.

Key Performance Indicators

  • SLA attainment - response and resolution within target.
  • First-time-fix and ticket-deflection rates; a controlled escalation rate to L3.
  • Quality and completeness of escalations (diagnosis, steps, context).
  • Knowledge-base contributions and documentation upkeep.
  • Customer satisfaction (CSAT) for application support.

Personal Attributes

  • Strong customer-oriented mindset with an exceptional service focus.
  • Ability to prioritise tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong teamwork, collaboration and interpersonal skills.
  • Continuous learner - adaptable and proactive.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organisational skills.
  • Immediate joining preferred; maximum notice period of 30 working days.
  • Flexible to work on demand and on rotational shifts as required.
  • Willingness to relocate near the office if residing 20 km or more away.

Working Pattern

Full-time, based in Chennai. For dedicated 24x7 client engagements, the role operates on a rotational shift basis (including nights and weekends) with clean handovers.

We are hiring for a new team within Core Identity, the Engineering organization entrusted with the very heart of the Auth0 application. You will primarily work with our NodeJS backend (TypeScript/JavaScript), with data stored in MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Redis, all running on a multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS and Azure). Cyncly & The Power of AI
At Cyncly, we believe in unlocking the power of AI to deliver highly personalized and extraordinary experiences for our customers and their clients. We are on a dynamic journey of seeking exceptional talent to add critical AI models and functionality to our products used by over 17,000 customers worldwide. This is opportunity to be a part of a collaborative team that fosters continuous learning and growth, where you'll work on exciting data driven projects that redefine the Spaces for Living industry. AI is reshaping private and business life at an unprecedented speed, and Cyncly is committed to leading the charge in delivering new sources of value for our customers.



Availability between 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST is required to support collaboration with our global teams.



About the role
We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer - SDLC to serve as a core technical builder to drive adoption and excellence in AI-assisted development across our engineering organization. This role will empower developers and technical teams to leverage AI tools effectively, accelerating development velocity while maintaining code quality and engineering standards.



Key Position Responsibilities Include:
Design & Develop AI Solutions

  • Build AI/ML and GenAI-powered tools to optimize SDLC stages (requirements, coding, testing, deployment, maintenance).
  • Develop intelligent systems for code generation, review, testing automation, defect prediction and democratizing large respos for new users.

Improve Engineering Productivity

  • Identify bottlenecks in development workflows and implement AI-driven optimizations. Reduce cycle time through automation and intelligent decision-support systems.

GenAI & LLM Integration

  • Design and implement solutions using LLMs (e.g., GPT and open-source models) for code assistance, documentation generation, test case generation, and end-to-end application or feature development from PRDs.

Platform & Tooling Development

  • Build reusable AI agents, APIs, and internal tools that can be adopted across engineering teams. Integrate AI solutions with existing DevOps tools, including CI/CD pipelines, issue-tracking systems, and version-control platforms.

Data & Model Engineering

  • Work with structured and unstructured engineering data, including code repositories, logs, and tickets. Fine-tune models and develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines where required.

Governance & Best Practices

  • Ensure responsible AI usage, model performance monitoring, and security compliance. Establish standards and best practices for AI-assisted software development.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

  • Bachelors/masters in computer science, AI, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with strong exposure to AI/ML.
  • Proven experience building AI/ML or GenAI-based products.
  • Strong polyglot programming skills (Python, Java, c# etc) and ability to adapt to various launguage ecosystems.
  • Hands-on experience with:LLMs (OpenAI, Hugging Face, etc.), Prompt engineering and evaluation, RAG architectures and vector databases.
  • Experience with Agentic frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, or LangChain).
  • Hands-on experience utilizing, evaluating, and fine-tuning open-source models (e.g., Qwen, DeepSeek, Llama, GLM) to automate key SDLC workflows is a strong advantage.
  • Familiarity with frameworks like vLLM or Ollama.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture, system design and modern DevOps practices.
  • Proven Experience with ASTs (Abstract Syntax Trees) and code-parsing tools like Tree-sitter or LSP (Language Server Protocols).
  • Hands on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j, Arango DB or similar) and their application in Knowledge Graphs or GraphRAG.

Core Competencies:

  • Measurable reduction in SDLC cycle time.
  • Increased developer productivity and efficiency.
  • Improved code quality and reduced defect leakage.
  • High adoption of AI tools across engineering teams.


Working for Us
At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.


Here, youll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. Youll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.


We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.


If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.

This comprehensive report will serve as a valuable resource for stakeholders, highlighting the steps taken to combat the cybersecurity incident and provide remediation guidance.

The ideal candidate for this role will possess extensive experience leading incident response efforts, a deep understanding of cybersecurity threats and mitigation strategies, and the ability to communicate complex technical information to executive-level stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.

title: Manager, Quality Digital Systems
jobDescription:
Use Your Power for Purpose


Every day, our unwavering commitment to quality ensures the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our flexible, innovative, and customer-oriented culture is rooted in science and risk-based compliance. Whether you are involved in development, maintenance, compliance, or analysis through research programs, your contribution directly impacts patients.


What You Will Achieve

The Manager, Quality Digital Systems will serve as a subject matter expert for RQA s digital quality systems, with experience in Veeva eQMS configuration and GxP-regulated system operations. This role is accountable for the reliable administration and continuous improvement of Veeva eQMS processes, including access management, business administration, release coordination, and reporting. The successful candidate will bring configuration expertise - understanding vault object relationships, shared versus instance-specific configuration, and the downstream consequences of proposed system changes - enabling faster, better-informed decisions on enhancement requests and system design questions. The successful candidate must understand stakeholder needs, assess business and technical trade-offs, and support technology decisions that advance quality operations and broader business objectives.


Beyond day-to-day operations, this role independently represents the RQA Digital Systems team within cross-functional programs and enterprise initiatives. This includes scoping RQA s responsibilities within a given program and developing and driving the execution plan on behalf of the team. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, maintaining clear situational awareness across assigned responsibilities and bringing issues and decisions forward proactively.


This position requires deep Veeva domain knowledge, strong analytical and organizational skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a regulated pharmaceutical environment, both as a technical advisor and as an accountable owner of complex, cross-functional work.

Responsibilities:

Veeva eQMS Operations Administration

  • Serve as the primary business administrator for Veeva eQMS on behalf of Regulatory Quality Assurance.
  • Manage and resolve system administration tickets requiring business-level intervention; triage and escalate as appropriate.
  • Own access request intake and provisioning across RQA s digital systems environments
  • Support Veeva release coordination through UAT, business approvals and communications, and production deployments.
  • Maintain and continuously improve job aids, quick reference guides, and user-facing documentation for Veeva eQMS and integrated supporting tools, keeping materials current across system releases.
  • Develop, prepare, and deliver reporting across functional areas.

eQMS Systems Expertise Advisory

  • Provide authoritative guidance on Veeva vault configuration options in support of the businesses needs, including object relationships, shared configuration dependencies, and the downstream impact of proposed changes.
  • Support the triage and formulation of eQMS enhancement requests, providing technical context and impact assessment alongside stakeholder needs and operational impacts to inform prioritization and decision-making.
  • Stay current on Veeva platform developments and GxP digital systems best practices, especially with respect to emerging AI technologies, applying that knowledge to improve system design and operational outcomes.
  • Participate in eQMS governance forums, representing RQA Digital Systems interests and staying current on platform developments.

Cross-Functional Program Support

  • Independently represent the RQA Digital Systems team within enterprise programs and initiatives requiring digital systems support, scoping team responsibilities, developing execution plans, and delivering against them.
  • Maintain clear ownership of workstream status and decisions; proactively surface blockers or escalation points to leadership.
  • Coordinate with Pfizer Digital and cross-functional teams to support enterprise quality data integrity and system continuity efforts.

Reporting Data Operations

  • Issue clear and timely communications, ensuring stakeholders are informed and aligned on timelines and expected outcomes
  • Execute periodic data extracts and reporting tasks in support of regulatory and quality operations, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and appropriate documentation.
  • Develop and maintain operational documentation and user guidance for current and legacy quality systems to ensure operational continuity.
  • Gather, synthesize, and prepare materials for stakeholder communications and leadership briefings, translating system and data insights into accessible formats.

Transformation Continuous Improvement

  • Proactively identify opportunities for meaningful process improvement and digital transformation within RQA s quality systems operations, bringing both technical grounding and operational context to proposed solutions.
  • Apply practical AI knowledge to evaluate use cases, partner with technical teams, and support adoption of AI-enabled solutions.
  • Contribute to and support broader organizational transformation initiatives, including AI integration into quality workflows, eQMS process redesign, and platform evolution.
  • Stay current on Veeva platform capabilities, GxP digital systems trends, and regulatory expectations, applying emerging best practices to improve the team s operations and delivery.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

  • Bachelor s degree in Life Sciences, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field with 5+ years of relevant industry experience; advanced degree preferred.

  • Experience in a GxP-regulated pharmaceutical or biotech environment with demonstrated understanding of quality management system processes.
  • Proven ability to operate autonomously and collaboratively on complex, cross-functional work.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to assess the downstream impact of system changes and translate business needs into actionable system decisions.

jobDescription:

Sophos is seeking an experienced and motivated Incident Response Consultant to join our Incident Response (IR) service.
