jobDescription:
About J-PAL South Asia:
J-PAL is a global research centre working to reduce poverty and fight climate change by ensuring that policy is informed by scientific evidence. Anchored by a network of over 1,100 researchers at universities across the world, J-PAL works with governments, NGOs, and donors to generate evidence and scale effective solutions. J-PAL South Asia, based at the Institute for Financial Management and Research (IFMR) in Chennai, leads J-PAL s efforts to advance evidence-informed policymaking across the region. The office works with over 20 state governments and multiple central ministries in India, across sectors including health, education, labour markets, energy, environment, climate action, and gender.
J-PAL South Asia hosts CLEAR South Asia, the Regional Centre for Learning on Evaluation and Results, coordinated by the World Bank s Independent Evaluation Group (IEG). CLEAR South Asia is a key implementing partner of the Global Evaluation Initiative (GEI), a global network of institutions dedicated to strengthening evaluation capacities in developing countries.
About the Training Vertical:
The Training vertical at J-PAL South Asia works to strengthen monitoring, evaluation, data, and evidence-use capacities and systems. The team delivers open-enrolment and customised courses, technical advisory services, fellowships, knowledge products, and long-term institutional capacity-building engagements with governments and other development partners. J-PAL South Asia also hosts CLEAR South Asia, a key implementing partner of the Global Evaluation Initiative.
Role Summary:
J-PAL South Asia seeks a data-focused Training Manager / Senior Manager to lead the design and delivery of capacity-building programmes that help public institutions and social-sector organisations improve how they collect, manage, analyse, govern, and use data for decision-making and evaluation. The role sits at the intersection of applied data analytics, monitoring and evaluation, adult learning, and institutional strengthening.
The successful candidate will translate real-world administrative and programme data challenges into rigorous, practice-oriented curricula and advisory engagements. They will lead technical content development, facilitate training for diverse audiences, manage partnerships and programmes, mentor team members, and help build a portfolio of data-capacity initiatives that is closely connected to J-PAL s research and policy mission.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Data-focused training strategy and portfolio development
    • Support the development and execution of the Training vertical s strategy for data and evidence capacity building, translating priorities into annual plans, milestones, budgets, and measurable outcomes.
    • Contribute to thought leadership on the evolving role of data systems, AI, and digital tools in M&E practice, helping government partners navigate opportunities and risks as these technologies reshape how evidence is generated and used in public systems.
    • Identify opportunities for new courses, technical assistance, fellowships, and institutional partnerships focused on administrative data, data governance, analytics, and evidence use.
    • Build a coherent pathway from foundational data literacy to advanced applied analytics, tailored to the needs of government officials, M&E practitioners, researchers, and implementing organisations.
    • Contribute to fundraising, proposal development, donor engagement, and the stewardship of existing grants.
  • Curriculum and technical content development
    • Lead the design, adaptation, and quality assurance of curricula, teaching materials, exercises, datasets, manuals, toolkits, and knowledge products on data-focused topics.
    • Develop applied learning content using realistic government and social-sector datasets, while ensuring confidentiality, ethical use, and appropriate data protection.
    • Create training modules for partners on topics such as data quality assessment, data cleaning and validation, reproducible workflows, administrative data systems, data visualisation, dashboarding, data governance, responsible data use, and the use of data for monitoring and evaluation.
    • Translate technical concepts into accessible and engaging learning experiences for audiences with different levels of quantitative proficiency.
    • Keep content current by drawing on J-PAL research, field experience, partner needs, and emerging good practices in public-interest data systems.
  • Training delivery and facilitation
    • Lead and facilitate high-quality in-person, virtual, and blended training programmes for government and non-government stakeholders.
    • Teach technical sessions and oversee hands-on labs using relevant software such as Excel, Stata, R, Python, SQL, or data-visualisation tools.
    • Design assessments, assignments, capstone exercises, and feedback mechanisms that measure learning and application rather than participation alone.
    • Coach other trainers and subject-matter experts to ensure consistency, accuracy, strong pedagogy, and an inclusive learner experience.
  • Technical advisory and institutional data-capacity strengthening
    • Work with state and central government partners, civil society organisations, and other institutions to diagnose data-system and analytical-capacity gaps.
    • Translate partner needs into feasible technical assistance plans, including data-quality protocols, documentation standards, reporting frameworks, analytical workflows, and capacity-building roadmaps.
    • Advise partners on strengthening data collection, metadata, data dictionaries, codebooks, validation rules, reproducible analysis, and responsible data-sharing practices.
    • Support partners to move from one-off analysis towards institutionalised routines for monitoring, learning, and evidence-informed decision-making.
    • Coordinate with J-PAL s research and policy teams to identify data assets and problem statements that may support future research or evaluation opportunities.
  • Programme and partnership management
    • Manage multiple training and advisory engagements end to end, including scoping, work planning, staffing, contracting, delivery, risk management, reporting, and close-out.
    • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior government officials, donors, universities, technical partners, and civil society organisations.
    • Ensure programmes are responsive to partner needs while maintaining J-PAL s standards for technical quality and ethical data use.
    • Represent the Training vertical in external meetings, workshops, and ecosystem convenings.
  • Learning, knowledge management, and evidence of programme effectiveness
    • Develop monitoring, evaluation, and learning frameworks for data-capacity programmes, tracking learning gains, application of skills, institutional adoption, and improvements in data practices.
    • Create and maintain reusable repositories of curricula, code examples, teaching datasets, templates, case studies, and delivery guidance.
    • Lead the production of practical briefs, case notes, playbooks, and donor-facing learning products that document what works in strengthening institutional data capacity.
    • Use learner and partner feedback to continuously improve programme design and delivery.
  • Team leadership and organisational contribution
    • Supervise, mentor, and support Training Associates, Senior Training Associates, consultants as the need may be.
    • Set clear goals and quality standards, review technical outputs, and support the professional development of team members.
    • Contribute to financial and operational management, grant reporting, recruitment, and cross-vertical organisational initiatives.
    • Promote a collaborative culture that combines technical rigour, practical problem-solving, and strong partner orientation.

The Senior Backend Engineer (Python / AI Systems) will be responsible for designing, building, and scaling backend systems that power AI-driven and data-intensive enterprise applications.   • Develop secure, high-performance RESTful and/or event-driven APIs for internal and external consumption

  • Implement robust data storage, caching, and retrieval mechanisms
  • Ensure system reliability through proper error handling, logging, and monitoring

  • Experience building scalable APIs and backend services using modern frameworks
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and backend system design
  • Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases
  • Familiarity with handling large datasets, data pipelines, and asynchronous processing
  • Experience integrating AI/ML models into backend services
  • Understanding of cloud-native architectures and distributed systems
  • Experience with version control, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployments
Skills & Competencies
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to design systems with scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind
  • Excellent collaboration skills across engineering, analytics, and product teams
  • Ownership mindset with focus on quality and long-term system health
  • Ability to work independently and drive complex backend initiatives
Preferred / Good to Have
  • Experience working with AI/ML platforms, analytics engines, or data-heavy systems
  • Exposure to real-time data processing or event-driven architectures
  • Familiarity with containerization and cloud deployment practices
  • Experience in industrial, energy, or enterprise SaaS environments

Senior Product Designer - Kefilo

Role: Senior Product Designer / Founding Product Team Member
Company: Kefilo
Compensation: Equity Only
Work Mode: Remote / Part-time
Commitment: 20-25 hours/week

About Kefilo

Kefilo is building a human transformation ecosystem focused on functional nutrition, preventive wellness, gut health and lifestyle redesign.

We are building beyond a traditional food-delivery model, with a focus on personalized nutrition, 90-day transformation programs, measurable outcomes, customer engagement and technology-enabled wellness.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer who can take ownership of the product design function at Kefilo and help design a simple, intuitive and scalable digital experience for our customers and internal teams.

The role will involve understanding customer problems, designing user journeys, building the app experience, creating design systems and working closely with the founder, developers, nutritionists and operations team to turn business and customer requirements into a strong product.

This is an equity-based founding team opportunity for someone who wants to take ownership of product design and help shape Kefilos digital ecosystem from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end product design process from user research and problem definition to wireframes, prototypes and final UI.

  • Design intuitive mobile and web experiences for customers, nutritionists, operations and internal teams.

  • Design user journeys for meal subscriptions, personalized nutrition, transformation programs, assessments, progress tracking and customer engagement.

  • Convert complex nutrition and wellness information into simple and easy-to-understand user experiences.

  • Conduct user research, competitor analysis and usability testing to identify customer needs and product improvements.

  • Create wireframes, user flows, high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes using Figma or similar tools.

  • Develop and maintain a consistent design system, component library and product design guidelines.

  • Work closely with developers to ensure designs are implemented accurately and efficiently.

  • Collaborate with nutritionists, food scientists, marketing and operations teams to understand requirements and translate them into product experiences.

  • Design dashboards and internal tools for customer management, subscriptions, nutrition, kitchen operations and business analytics.

  • Design data visualizations and progress-tracking interfaces that help customers understand their transformation journey.

  • Continuously analyse user feedback, product behaviour and usability issues and improve the product accordingly.

  • Explore how AI and personalization can be incorporated into the customer experience.

  • Help establish the overall visual language, interaction principles and digital brand experience for Kefilo.

Ideal Candidate

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in product design, UX/UI design or digital product development.

  • Strong proficiency in Figma and modern product design tools.

  • Strong understanding of UX research, information architecture, user flows, interaction design and visual design.

  • Experience designing mobile-first products and responsive web applications.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating real-world digital products and end-to-end design processes.

  • Ability to simplify complex information and create intuitive user experiences.

  • Experience with consumer apps, D2C, health-tech, wellness, food-tech or subscription products is an advantage.

  • Understanding of design systems and developer handoff.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.

  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership in an early-stage startup.

  • Interest in nutrition, wellness, technology, AI and consumer products is an advantage.

What You Get

  • Founding Senior Product Designer position at Kefilo.

  • Equity participation.

  • Direct collaboration with the founder and multidisciplinary founding team.

  • Opportunity to shape Kefilos digital product and customer experience from the ground up.

  • Ownership of the product design system and overall digital experience.

  • Opportunity to work at the intersection of food, nutrition, wellness, technology and transformation.

  • Potential to grow into a core product/design leadership role as Kefilo scales.

Important

This is an equity-only opportunity with no fixed salary at the current stage.

The expected contribution is 20-25 hours per week on a remote, part-time basis. We are looking for someone genuinely interested in building long-term value and taking ownership of a core product function.

The founder onboarding process includes 3-4 strategic discussions followed by a 1-month NDA-based collaboration phase to evaluate expertise, execution, ownership and long-term alignment.

Equity will be structured based on contribution, responsibility and commitment, with a 5-year vesting structure for core founding members.

Fixed compensation will be introduced after fundraising and revenue stabilization.

If you are primarily looking for a fixed-salary position, this opportunity may not be suitable at the current stage.

Data AI/ML (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) Engineering involves the use of algorithms and statistical models to enable systems to analyze data, learn patterns, and make data-driven predictions or decisions without explicit human programming. AI/ML applications leverage vast amounts of data to identify insights, automate processes, and solve complex problems across a wide range of fields, including healthcare, finance, e-commerce, and more. AI/ML processes transform raw data into actionable intelligence, enabling automation, predictive analytics, and intelligent solutions. Data AI/ML combines advanced statistical modeling, computational power, and data engineering to build intelligent systems that can learn, adapt, and automate decisions.
AI/ML Engineer (Data Engineering + AI Focus)

A.P. Moller Maersk is the global leader in container shipping services. The business operates in 130 countries and employs 80,000 staff. An integrated container logistics company, Maersk aims to connect and simplify its customers supply chains.

jobDescription:
Senior Agentic AI Engineer

About the Role

Insurance software implementations are among the most complex, document-heavy, and process-intensive programmes in enterprise technology. A single implementation can involve thousands of configuration decisions, hundreds of requirement documents, and years of delivery time. Sapiens is rebuilding how that work gets done using production-grade AI agents that operate across the full implementation lifecycle, from pre-sales and scoping through to configuration, testing, and go-live.

Work You'll Do

Agent architecture & orchestration

  • Design and implement agentic systems capable of multi-step reasoning, planning, tool use, and workflow execution against complex, document-intensive implementation processes
  • Build stateful workflows using LangGraph or equivalent — including branching, retries, self-correction, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and reusable orchestration patterns
  • Engineer for long-horizon reliability — multi-step task completion, recovery from compounding errors, planning under uncertainty, and robust tool use when individual steps fail
  • Build the reasoning behind high-stakes implementation decisions — criteria-grounded outputs, structured review patterns, and auditable rationales that delivery consultants can act on and defend

Retrieval, grounding & context engineering

  • Develop end-to-end RAG pipelines: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid retrieval, reranking, contextual compression, and grounding strategies
  • Engineer memory and context management — conversational state, persistent memory, retrieval-aware context assembly, and token-efficient context selection
  • Apply MCP-style tool and context interfaces so agents access the right information at the right time across enterprise knowledge repositories, document sources, and structured configuration data

Reliability, evaluation & safety

  • Implement observability and tracing for prompts, tool calls, retrieval quality, agent traces, failures, drift, latency, and production behaviour
  • Apply guardrails, safety controls, and failure-handling to reduce hallucinations in agents whose outputs practitioners act on directly in live client settings
  • Evaluate agents at trajectory and task level — multi-step task success, failure-mode and regression analysis, sandboxed test environments — alongside retrieval and generation quality metrics, automated checks, and human review

Integration & production craft

  • Build integrations with internal and external tools, APIs, enterprise systems, databases, and model providers so agents operate reliably within real delivery workflows
  • Deliver production-quality Python code with strong practices in testing, CI/CD, logging, versioning, and documentation; make architecture decisions that balance quality, reliability, latency, cost, and model risk
  • Translate ambiguous, high-complexity implementation processes into robust system logic and reusable AI patterns; stay current with advances in agentic systems and translate research into practical engineering decisions

Required Qualifications

  • Strong, hands-on experience with LangGraph or equivalent agentic orchestration frameworks, including custom orchestration
  • Deep proficiency in Python — clean, testable, production-ready code

  • Daily working proficiency with Claude (Anthropic API) and Claude Code — you use these tools every day, not occasionally
  • Experience building and deploying agents on Azure AI Foundry or an equivalent enterprise cloud AI platform
  • Practical understanding of LLM behaviour — strengths, limitations, hallucination risks, reasoning constraints, and the evaluation methods used to measure them
  • Experience evaluating and debugging agent behaviour at trajectory and task level, not just output quality
  • Hands-on experience with MCP-based interoperability patterns and tool-calling agent design
  • Modern software practices: testing, CI/CD, observability, tracing, and debugging for LLM-based systems in production

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with vector databases — Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search, OpenSearch

Bajaj Finserv Web is a critical component of the company's omnipresence strategy. You will be working with India's largest NBFC's web technology stack, encompassing over 40 business lines and 230+ features, with nearly 500 million traffic and managing over 30,000 webpages. It is an integrated platform offering a portfolio of products covering payments, cards, wallets, loans, deposits, mutual funds, and loans on lifestyle products, ranging from consumer durables to home furnishings. The Software Development Manager (SDM) - Full Stack leads a single POD of 5-7 developers building the experience and services layer of this platform on Next.js, React and Node JS. Reporting to the Technical Architect - Frontend, the role converts approved architecture and design system standards into production-grade full stack implementations - server rendered and statically generated pages, shared components, BFF and API integration layers - and is accountable for the POD's delivery predictability, Core Web Vitals, code quality and compliance posture. The role is expected to remain hands-on, conduct code reviews, enforce engineering standards and SOPs, and continuously raise the productivity of the POD through automation and AI-assisted engineering.
Responsibilities
  • Data Privacy and Security: Ensure all development within the POD complies with applicable data privacy regulation, RBI and internal information security policy, including data localisation requirements for any cloud or AI service used.
  • Secure SDLC: Enforce secure coding practices covering the OWASP Top 10, dependency and supply chain scanning, secrets management, and timely closure of VAPT and application security findings.
  • Browser and Client Security: Ensure correct implementation of CSP, XSS and CSRF protection, secure token and session handling in the browser, and governance of third-party scripts and tags on the POD's surfaces.
  • Audit Readiness: Maintain traceability from requirement to code to release - approvals, change records, test evidence and deployment records - so that internal audit and regulatory reviews can be served without rework.
  • Incident Management: Own the POD's participation in production incident response, root cause analysis and preventive action tracking, ensuring minimal customer impact.
  • Innovation and Engineering Productivity: Execute POCs to validate frameworks, rendering approaches and migration paths with clear benchmarking on performance, cost and scalability before adoption.
  • Innovation and Engineering Productivity: Drive adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering within the POD - code generation, review assistance, test generation and design-to-code workflows - with measurable impact on velocity and quality and with clear guardrails on data, IP and security.
  • Innovation and Engineering Productivity: Support the migration of the existing CMS rendered estate to a composable Next.js frontend for the POD's scope, ensuring zero regression on organic traffic, analytics and compliance sensitive journeys.
  • Innovation and Engineering Productivity: Leverage and sponsor innovation work through internal incubators and the external start-up network to introduce novel technical capabilities into the platform.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Maintain a technical debt and dependency upgrade register for the POD's codebase with an agreed remediation plan, including supply chain risk across the dependency tree.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Establish frontend observability for the POD - real user monitoring, synthetic checks and error tracking through New Relic, Datadog and Lighthouse CI - and act on the telemetry.
  • POD and Team Management: Technical Mentorship: Provide day to day technical guidance to 5-7 developers, run design and code walkthroughs, and build depth in the POD through structured learning paths and pair programming.
  • POD and Team Management: Performance Management: Set clear, measurable goals for every team member, conduct regular one-on-ones and reviews, give constructive feedback, and close the appraisal cycle within timelines.
  • POD and Team Management: Capacity and Resource Planning: Allocate work across the POD based on story complexity, skill fit and individual development needs, maintain sprint velocity and utilisation, and flag capacity risks to the Technical Architect early.
  • POD and Team Management: Talent Acquisition and Retention: Participate in hiring panels, own the technical evaluation of candidates for the POD, and run structured onboarding and ramp-up plans for new joiners, byte hires and partner resources.
  • POD and Team Management: Partner Management: Manage in-POD vendor and partner developers to the same standard of quality, hygiene and delivery discipline as internal engineers.
  • POD and Team Management: Team Collaboration: Build a cohesive POD with strong communication into Product, Design, Content, QA and infrastructure teams, and maintain high engagement and morale.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Own end-to-end delivery for the POD - sprint planning, estimation, build, code review, testing, release and post-release stabilisation - for all web and in-app surfaces in scope.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Translate the solution design provided by the Technical Architect into implementable low-level designs, component specifications, API and data contracts, and task breakdowns for the POD.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Remain hands-on for a meaningful share of the role (target 30-40%) on Next.js and React development with TypeScript, including App Router, React Server Components, SSR, SSG, ISR and streaming.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Own the POD's Node JS services and BFF layer - route handlers, API aggregation, GraphQL and REST consumption, caching, resilience patterns, timeouts and error handling.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Consume and contribute to the enterprise design system and shared component library, ensuring token, theming, versioning and Storybook discipline rather than local forks and one-off components.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Implement integration with headless content sources (AEM headless or other CMS/DXP), commerce and backend services through the contract layer defined by the Architect.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Own state management, data fetching and form and validation architecture within the POD's applications, keeping patterns consistent with the platform standard.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Own edge and caching behaviour for the POD's routes in partnership with CDN teams - cache key design, revalidation, purge strategy and origin protection across Akamai and Cloudflare.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Drive release readiness through build checklists, feature flag and progressive rollout plans, deployment runbooks, rollback plans and production hypercare for every deployment.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Ensure the POD's digital assets continue to perform through peak sales season by designing for auto-scale, graceful degradation and resilient rendering across the Node / SSR tier, CDN and origin.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Define and enforce coding standards, branching strategy, peer review, merge and promotion discipline across the POD using Git, GitHub Actions or Jenkins, and monorepo and package governance conventions.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Own quality gates - SonarQube, static analysis, code coverage, bundle size checks, Lighthouse CI budgets and automated security scanning - and hold the line on defect density and escaped defects.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Own the POD's Core Web Vitals outcomes (LCP, INP, CLS) including bundle analysis and code splitting, image and font strategy, hydration cost, streaming and partial prerendering, with explicit optimisation for low-end Android devices, low bandwidth networks and in-app webviews.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Ensure testing coverage across unit, component, contract and end-to-end layers using Jest, Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress, along with visual regression, before any release is certified.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Own SEO, GEO, structured data, render parity and accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) as build-time concerns for the POD rather than post-release corrections.
Key Decisions / Dimensions
  • Following decisions are taken by the role:
  • Low-level design and component design decisions within the boundaries of the architecture and design system standards approved by the Technical Architect.
  • Rendering mode selection per route - SSR, SSG, ISR or client rendering - within the strategy defined by the Architect.
  • Implementation approach for BFF and API integration, state management, error handling and resilience patterns for the POD's scope.
  • Sprint scope, story sequencing, estimation and allocation of work across the 5-7 developers in the POD

Why This Role Exists

Jira Service Management has evolved into a critical enterprise platform supporting IT Asset Management, Vulnerability Management, Incident Management, Change Management, and key operational workflows. Recent regulatory examinations and our cybersecurity program have reinforced the importance of maintaining a complete and accurate IT asset inventory the foundation for vulnerability management, incident response, disaster recovery, and regulatory reporting.

To date, the platform has been maintained by team members as part of broader responsibilities. As its scope and strategic importance have grown, we now require dedicated expertise and capacity to maintain the platform, develop integrations with systems such as automated asset discovery, enhance workflows, and ensure ongoing data quality. A dedicated ITSM Platform Engineer will own this critical platform reducing operational risk, improving automation and efficiency, and ensuring the reliable asset and operational data needed to support regulatory expectations and our cybersecurity strategy.

Job Purpose

We are seeking an experienced Jira Administrator / JSM Engineer to own the administration, configuration, governance, and ongoing support of Jira Software, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Confluence. This role serves as the primary platform administrator responsible for designing and maintaining workflows, forms, automation, asset-management processes, service catalogs, reporting, and integrations that support Technology, Operations, Security, and Business teams across the enterprise. The ideal candidate combines strong technical administration skills with process expertise in Asset Management (Asset Inventory), Incident Management, Change Management, Service Request Management, and Agile delivery practices.

Key Responsibilities

Atlassian Platform Administration

  • Administer and maintain Jira Software, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Confluence.
  • Configure and manage projects, issue types, workflows, screens, custom fields, permissions, notification schemes, and security roles.
  • Maintain platform health, performance, reliability, and data integrity.
  • Implement platform governance standards, naming conventions, and configuration best practices.
  • Manage user provisioning, licensing, access controls, and security configurations.

Jira Service Management (JSM)

  • Configure and maintain JSM service desks, queues, request types, SLAs, customer portals, and service catalogs.
  • Design and enhance Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, and Service Request workflows.
  • Build and maintain incident, problem, change, release, and operational-support forms.
  • Configure approval workflows, escalation paths, notifications, and service-level management processes.
  • Partner with Production Support, Infrastructure, Security, and Application teams to optimize ITSM processes.

Assets & Configuration Management

  • Administer Jira Service Management Assets (CMDB).
  • Design and maintain asset schemas, object types, relationships, and data models.
  • Develop processes for managing hardware, software, cloud resources, applications, and technology assets.
  • Establish asset lifecycle management processes including onboarding, changes, audits, and retirement.
  • Implement integrations between Assets and incident, change, and service-request processes.
  • Ensure asset data quality, governance, and reporting accuracy.

Workflow Configuration & Automation

  • Design, develop, and maintain Jira workflows that support business and technology processes.
  • Configure automation rules to streamline approvals, notifications, escalations, and repetitive tasks.
  • Develop and support integrations with enterprise tools and external systems.
  • Drive continuous-improvement initiatives that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports, KPIs, and executive metrics.
  • Provide reporting on incident trends, SLA performance, change effectiveness, asset compliance, and operational health.
  • Develop meaningful analytics that support management decision-making and process improvements.

User Support & Enablement

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for Jira and JSM platform issues.
  • Provide user training, documentation, and best-practice guidance.
  • Partner with stakeholders to capture requirements and deliver platform enhancements.
  • Support onboarding of new teams and business units onto the Atlassian platform.

  • Experience with Agile, Scrum, and Kanban methodologies.

What the Client Expects

Agent architecture & orchestration

title: AI Automation Test Engineer - Playwright (Web & Mobile)
jobDescription:
Job Summary


We are seeking an AI Automation Test Engineer with strong hands-on Playwright expertise to build, scale, and maintain intelligent test automation for web and mobile applications. This role has a specific mandate: migrate and modernise existing Java-based Selenium test suites to Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript), while embedding AI-assisted techniques (AI-generated test cases, self-healing locators, MCP-enabled tooling, LLM-based test data and failure triage) into the day-to-day QA workflow.

The ideal candidate has already led or contributed materially to a Java Selenium Playwright migration, can quantify the outcome (execution time, flakiness, maintenance effort), and is comfortable using AI tooling as a force multiplier rather than a novelty.


Role & responsibilities


Playwright Automation

  • Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end automation suites using Playwright with TypeScript/JavaScript across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
  • Build scalable framework architecture Page Object Model / fixtures, reusable components, config-driven environments, parallel and sharded execution.
  • Implement API testing within Playwright (request context) alongside UI coverage, plus Postman/Newman where required.
  • Use Playwright's tracing, video, screenshot, and network interception/mocking capabilities to make failures diagnosable on the first pass.
  • Implement visual regression and accessibility checks (e.g. Playwright snapshots, axe-core integration).

Selenium Playwright Migration

  • Audit the existing Java-based Selenium suites: assess coverage, redundancy, flakiness, and business criticality to define migration scope and sequencing.
  • Define the migration strategy and roadmap wave planning, coexistence approach, and criteria for rewrite vs. retire vs. defer.
  • Convert Java Selenium test scripts, locator strategies, waits, and utilities into TypeScript/JavaScript Playwright idioms (auto-waiting, web-first assertions, locators over raw selectors) a cross-language rewrite, not a line-by-line port.
  • Re-map Java-side supporting layers (TestNG/JUnit structures, Maven/Gradle build config, custom utilities, reporting hooks) to their Playwright/Node equivalents.
  • Run both suites in parallel during transition and reconcile results to prove functional equivalence before Selenium decommissioning.
  • Report migration KPIs: coverage parity, execution time reduction, flakiness rate, maintenance effort saved.

AI-Enabled Quality Engineering

  • Use AI tooling to accelerate test case generation, test data synthesis, and script scaffolding from requirements, user stories, or Figma designs.
  • Work with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and AI agent frameworks to enable AI-driven test execution, exploration, and reporting.
  • Implement self-healing locators and AI-assisted failure triage to reduce false positives and manual analysis time.
  • Apply AI to log/defect clustering, root-cause suggestion, and risk-based regression selection.
  • Critically validate all AI-generated output — accountability for correctness stays with the engineer.

Mobile Automation

  • Automate Android and iOS applications using Appium (and Playwright for mobile web / responsive viewports).
  • Execute across real devices, emulators/simulators, and cloud device farms (BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, LambdaTest).
  • Validate compatibility across OS versions, screen sizes, and form factors; ensure Google Play and Apple App Store guideline compliance.

CI/CD, Reporting & Collaboration

  • Integrate suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI) with quality gates and scheduled regression runs.
  • Containerise execution (Docker) and manage parallel/grid execution for speed at scale.
  • Publish actionable reporting and QA metrics — pass rate, flakiness, coverage, defect leakage, mean time to detect.
  • Manage defects end-to-end in Jira; drive clear reproduction steps and fast developer turnaround.
  • Participate in sprint planning, refinement, daily stand-ups, and QA reviews in an Agile/Scrum environment; contribute to shift-left and test-first practices.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers on Playwright and AI-assisted testing practices.


Preferred candidate profile


  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or related field.
  • 5 to 7 years of overall test automation experience, including at least 2 years hands-on Playwright in a production delivery context.
  • Demonstrable experience migrating test scripts from Java Selenium to Playwright — able to walk through scope, approach, pitfalls, and measured outcomes.
  • Strong programming ability in TypeScript/JavaScript, with a solid grasp of async/await patterns, Node tooling, and npm ecosystem.
  • Working proficiency in Java — sufficient to read, interpret, and refactor existing Selenium/TestNG codebases during migration.
  • Deep understanding of Selenium WebDriver — architecture, explicit/implicit waits, grid, and its limitations relative to Playwright.
  • Practical experience applying AI/LLM tools to testing (test generation, script authoring, triage, self-healing) — including awareness of their failure modes.
  • Exposure to MCP servers or comparable AI-agent tooling for test execution or orchestration.
  • API testing proficiency — REST, JSON schema validation, auth flows, Postman.
  • Mobile automation with Appium; working knowledge of Android Studio and Xcode basics.
  • Git-based workflows, code review discipline, and CI/CD pipeline experience.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • Performance testing — k6, JMeter, Gatling; Lighthouse for web performance.
  • Accessibility testing to WCAG 2.1 / 2.2 standards.
  • Cloud platform familiarity (Azure, AWS, GCP) and observability tooling.
  • Test management integration (Zephyr, Xray, TestRail) and BDD (Cucumber, Playwright-BDD).
  • Security testing basics (OWASP Top 10 awareness).
  • ISTQB certification or equivalent.

You own the technical success of Cogentiq I2C at a portfolio of strategic accounts. You take a business problem that arrives stated in finance terms, reduce our days sales outstanding, stop writing off small-balance deductions, and turn it into a production AI system that the customer s finance organisation actually uses.

  • Own the technical outcome for a portfolio of accounts, from discovery through production rollout and scale.
  • Set and defend the deployment KPI contract: accuracy, straight-through processing rate, latency, cost per transaction, adoption and business impact.
  • Hold the technical relationship with customer sponsors and IT leadership.
Solution design and architecture
  • Translate ambiguous goals into a solution design covering agent topology, retrieval strategy, human oversight boundaries, integration approach and data model.
  • Make and document the build versus configure versus extend-the-product calls. Decline bespoke work that cannot be maintained across the customer base.
  • Own the integration design against customer ERP, banking and document infrastructure.
Delivery leadership
  • Lead a deployment team of Forward Deployed Engineers and specialists. Scope the work, sequence it and unblock it.
  • Own proof-of-value and pilot scoping, including effort estimates and success criteria that can be measured rather than asserted.
  • Act as incident commander for production failures. Own the root cause analysis and the remediation plan.
Advisory
  • Explain to finance and IT leadership what the system can and cannot do and what residual risk remains after it is deployed.
  • Guide customers on governance, human oversight design, model risk and responsible AI.
Product and asset leadership
  • Convert deployment learnings into reusable assets: reference architectures, connector templates, evaluation packs and deployment accelerators.
  • Bring evidenced feedback to the product roadmap. Distinguish a single customer s preference from a genuine product gap.
What you bring
  • 6 to 10 years building and operating production systems, including at least two years in customer-facing delivery.
  • A track record of taking at least one non-trivial AI system to production and keeping it running afterwards.
  • Strong Python and system design depth.
  • Depth across LLM and agentic architectures, retrieval, evaluation methodology, guardrails and observability.
  • Cloud deployment experience at scale. Azure is preferred given our stack. Containers and orchestration.
  • Enough finance vocabulary to hold a conversation about DSO, deductions, remittance advice, and cash application without a translator or the evident ability to get there within a quarter.
  • Commercial judgement. You can recognise when a customer request has quietly become unpaid scope, and you raise it early.
  • Willingness to travel and embed with customers.
Nice to have
  • AI deployments in regulated industries.
  • Enterprise ERP integration experience, particularly SAP S/4HANA or Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations.
  • Experience mentoring or leading engineers.
  • Pre-sales or solution architecture exposure.
  • Startup or product-building experience where customer feedback shaped what got built.
What success looks like in your first year
  • Two accounts running in production against agreed KPIs.
  • The Forward Deployed Engineers on your team are measurably more capable than when they joined it.
  • At least two reusable assets you produced are in use by another deployment team.

Individual Contributor (IC)

title: Sr Data Platform Engineer(Microsoft Fabric,MLOps)
tagsAndSkills: data pipelines,azure machine learning,azure key vault,data engineer,airflow,ai,anomaly detection,azure data factory
jobDescription:
Coretek is seeking a Senior Engineer, Machine Learning and Data to build and operationalize Microsoft Fabric-first data and machine learning platforms for enterprise clients. This is a platform engineering role, not a data science role. You will not be building, training, or tuning models. Client data science teams own the models. You build the governed environments, pipelines, CI/CD automation, data quality gates, and observability that let those models run in production on a schedule, reproducibly, and under monitoring.

You will work as part of a distributed delivery team alongside US-based architects and project managers, implementing against an agreed architecture and owning significant technical workstreams end to end. Success in this role means the platform runs unattended, reproducibly, and under service identity, with clear runbooks that let the client operate it after handoff.

This is a full time seat on Coreteks Data and AI practice rather than a placement against a single project. Machine learning platform delivery is the focus, and between those engagements you will work across broader Microsoft Fabric and Azure data platform projects. We are hiring for a long career track, and we expect the mix of work to shift further toward generative AI platform delivery over time.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Build Microsoft Fabric workspace structures spanning Sandbox, Dev/Staging, and Production, including environment isolation, workspace naming and ownership, and Fabric RBAC patterns mapped to Entra ID groups.
  • Implement governed read access to enterprise data warehouse sources and controlled write-back into data science owned schemas, covering feature tables, model version metadata, model artifact references, prediction outputs, and experiment structures.
  • Develop reusable batch prediction pipeline templates covering data extraction, feature preparation, data quality validation, model execution, output validation, table write-back, and alerting.
  • Build forecasting pipeline patterns where they diverge from standard batch scoring, including time-series inputs, rolling forecasts, and horizon-based outputs.
  • Implement CI/CD for notebooks and platform assets: Git integration for Fabric, branching and pull request standards, automated unit and integration tests, Fabric deployment pipelines, Azure DevOps pipelines where Fabric-native capability falls short, and a single manual approval gate before production promotion.
  • Configure orchestration and scheduling across time-based, trigger-based, and manual execution, with DAG-style visibility that surfaces the failed stage.
  • Implement data quality gates covering schema validation, null and missing value thresholds, value range checks, and basic distributional anomaly detection, wired to block downstream model execution and raise an alert on failure.
  • Configure all unattended execution to run under managed identities or service principals with secrets held in Azure Key Vault. No scheduled or production process may depend on individual user credentials or interactive sessions.
  • Establish model, code, environment, and package versioning standards so any production run is traceable to a versioned combination of code, configuration, environment definition, and data reference, with a demonstrable rollback path.
  • Build monitoring and observability: compute and job health, ETL and pipeline execution status, data quality alerts, model drift detection and health-check notebooks, alert thresholds, and routing to client-designated channels.
  • Define package installation and pinning standards for Python and R, and enforce that only reviewed and approved dependencies reach production environments.
  • Validate that data science owned output tables are consumable by Power BI, and document the access pattern.
  • Produce operational runbooks, handoff documentation, and knowledge transfer material for client IT and data science teams.

These are the hard requirements. They are engineering requirements, not machine learning requirements.

  • 5+ years building and operating production data platforms on Microsoft Azure.
  • Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience: workspaces, OneLake, Lakehouse and Warehouse structures, Fabric Notebooks, Fabric RBAC, and deployment pipelines. Strong Synapse, Databricks, or Azure Data Factory backgrounds are welcome where the candidate has already moved onto Fabric or can credibly show they will.
  • Strong Python and SQL, with production-grade code structured for reuse, testing, and scheduled execution rather than exploratory notebooks alone.
  • CI/CD applied to data and notebook assets using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, including automated unit and integration testing.
  • Orchestration and scheduling experience with dependency management and pipeline-level failure visibility, using Fabric Data Pipelines, Azure Data Factory, Airflow, or equivalent.
  • Working knowledge of a data quality framework such as Great Expectations, Soda, or an equivalent rules-based validation approach.
  • Solid grasp of Azure identity and security: Entra ID, service principals, managed identities, Azure Key Vault, and RBAC. Specifically, experience making scheduled workloads run headless with no user-bound authentication.
  • Understanding of Power BI consumption patterns against lakehouse and warehouse tables, sufficient to validate and document downstream access.
  • Clear written English and the ability to produce runbooks and design documentation that a client operations team can follow without the author present.
  • Minimum four hours of daily overlap with US Eastern business hours for standups, design reviews, and milestone demonstrations.
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Machine Learning Operationalization

Working-level capability is required here. Deep specialization is not, and a modeling background is not.

  • Experience taking at least one machine learning model into scheduled production and keeping it running. The model itself may have been built by someone else.
  • Working understanding of model versioning and reproducibility, meaning what it takes to tie a production run back to a specific combination of code, configuration, environment, and data.
  • Experience operationalizing batch scoring or forecasting workloads on a schedule, including retry logic, failure handling, and output persistence.
  • Familiarity with monitoring model behavior in production, including drift or degradation in output quality.
  • Comfort wrapping and executing model code written by others, in Python and ideally R, without needing to change the model logic.

Preferred

  • Working knowledge of R in a platform context: R kernels in notebooks, renv for dependency pinning, and wrapping client-provided R workloads for scheduled execution. Client data science teams frequently write in R even when the platform is built in Python.
  • Time-series forecasting exposure, including rolling origin evaluation and horizon-based output structures.
  • Experimentation platform patterns: experiment configuration, metrics, treatment assignment, matched datasets, and result storage.
  • Model drift detection and baseline statistics monitoring in production.
  • Hands-on with MLflow, the Azure Machine Learning model registry, or an equivalent model tracking and registry tool.
  • Exposure to generative AI platform work such as retrieval-augmented generation, prompt and version management, or LLM evaluation. The practice mix is moving in this direction.
  • Infrastructure as Code with Bicep or Terraform.
  • Certifications such as Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700), Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600), Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100), Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203), or DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400).
  • Consulting or professional services delivery background, working to fixed scope and milestone acceptance.
  • Experience in a regulated or security-reviewed environment where third-party and open-source packages require formal approval before production use.

jobDescription:
Job Description


Job Overview

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, AI & ML Data Collection, you will play a critical role in building and scaling the company’s Unified AI/ML Data Collection Platform, enabling standardized, reliable, and scalable machine learning capabilities across the organization. This role will focus on transforming existing AI/ML and LLM-driven data systems into a cohesive platform that supports data pipelines, model lifecycle management, evaluation frameworks, and production deployment.

This position requires deep hands-on expertise in machine learning engineering, LLM-based systems, ML platform development, and MLOps. You will work closely with ML engineers, product managers, researchers, and business stakeholders to deliver production-ready AI/ML systems aligned with broader business objectives and AI/ML strategy.

You will be deeply involved in the design, development, and operationalization of platform components, including data ingestion, feature management, model training and evaluation, scalable inference systems, and model observability capabilities.

You will help ensure that AI/ML systems are production-ready, observable, maintainable, and cost-efficient, with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, governance, and developer productivity. You will leverage your expertise in areas such as large language models (LLM), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and ML Operations (MLOps).

You will contribute to the end-to-end lifecycle of ML systems, from experimentation and prototyping to deployment, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement while mentoring engineers and promoting strong engineering practices across the team.

Team Overview

You will be part of a multidisciplinary team of ML engineers responsible for building and maintaining the Unified AI/ML Data Collection Platform. The team focuses on developing scalable systems that support data pipelines, model lifecycle management, LLM-based workflows, and evaluation frameworks, enabling downstream teams to build and deploy AI-driven data collection solutions.

Outline of Duties and Responsibilities

  • AI-Powered Data Collection Systems: Design and develop scalable AI-driven data collection and enrichment workflows across structured and unstructured data sources.
  • LLM & Generative AI Workflows: Build LLM-based capabilities including RAG systems, prompt orchestration, entity extraction, summarization, classification, and automated validation workflows.
  • Agentic Frameworks & Model Context Integration: Design and implement agentic workflows and model-to-tool integrations that connect AI models with internal tools, APIs, knowledge stores, data sources, and workflow systems.
  • Model Deployment & Lifecycle Management: Deploy, maintain, and optimize ML and LLM models in production, including model versioning, CI/CD, experiment tracking, model registry, rollout strategies, and rollback mechanisms.
  • Data Quality & Evaluation: Build frameworks for evaluating extraction quality, model performance, hallucination risks, grounding, consistency, latency, coverage, and overall data reliability.
  • Observability & Operational Excellence: Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, cost tracking, model performance monitoring, drift detection, and reliability dashboards for production AI/ML systems.
  • Scalable Platform Engineering: Design distributed, event-driven, and cloud-native systems using asynchronous processing, message queues, containerization, and orchestration patterns to support high-volume workloads.
  • Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Evaluate emerging AI/ML technologies, LLM frameworks, orchestration tools, vector databases, and model deployment approaches to improve automation capabilities and developer productivity.
  • Company Values: Model company values and contribute to a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

Experience, Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering or data science, with a focus on machine learning systems, ML platforms, or distributed systems.
  • Strong experience building production-grade ML systems, including model deployment and lifecycle management.
  • Hands-on experience with MLOps tools and practices, including CI/CD, model monitoring, and experiment tracking.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, or similar languages.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and containerization (e.g., AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with LLM-based systems in production, including RAG pipelines, embeddings, and vector databases.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and system design trade-offs.
  • Proven ability to solve complex technical challenges and deliver scalable solutions.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across global teams.
  • Experience working in fast-paced, data-driven environments.

Working Conditions       

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phones on an ongoing basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

You own the technical success of Cogentiq I2C at a portfolio of strategic accounts. You take a business problem that arrives stated in finance terms, reduce our days sales outstanding, stop writing off small-balance deductions, and turn it into a production AI system that the customer s finance organisation actually uses.

You lead a small deployment team. You make the architecture calls. You are the person the customer sponsor calls when something is wrong, and the person who tells them what we will not build. This is an engineering role. You will still be in the codebase. The difference from the first band is that you also carry the account, the design and the team.

  • Own the technical outcome for a portfolio of accounts, from discovery through production rollout and scale.

  • Hold the technical relationship with customer sponsors and IT leadership.
Solution design and architecture
  • Translate ambiguous goals into a solution design covering agent topology, retrieval strategy, human oversight boundaries, integration approach and data model.
  • Make and document the build versus configure versus extend-the-product calls. Decline bespoke work that cannot be maintained across the customer base.
  • Own the integration design against customer ERP, banking and document infrastructure.
Delivery leadership

Advisory

Product and asset leadership

The Sr. Executive / Assistant Manager - MICE, Events, Hotels & Travel Procurement will be responsible for managing end-to-end sourcing and procurement activities related to MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Exhibitions), corporate events, hotels, business travel, employee travel, and related hospitality services.

The role will be responsible for identifying and developing vendors, negotiating competitive commercial terms, managing RFQs/RFPs, evaluating proposals, coordinating bookings and event requirements, managing contracts, and ensuring cost-effective and high-quality services. The position will work closely with Business, HR, Administration, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Sales, and other internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of events and travel requirements while maintaining compliance with company procurement policies and approval processes.

Responsibilities

  • MICE & Event Procurement: Manage end-to-end procurement for corporate events, conferences, meetings, exhibitions, offsites, dealer/distributor meets, employee events, town halls, award functions and incentive programs. Understand event requirements including venue, accommodation, food & beverage, transportation, branding, audio-visual, production, entertainment, manpower and other event-related services. Identify and onboard suitable event management agencies, production houses, destination management companies (DMCs), and other event service providers. Float RFQs/RFPs and obtain competitive commercial proposals from multiple vendors. Prepare detailed commercial comparisons covering venue, food & beverage, room rates, production, AV, transportation, manpower and other event costs. Negotiate event packages, venue charges, minimum guarantees, cancellation terms, attrition clauses and other commercial conditions. Support business teams in finalizing venues and vendors based on commercial, quality, location, capacity, and service parameters. Monitor event budgets and identify opportunities for cost optimization. Ensure timely closure of event-related procurement activities and vendor payments.
  • Hotel & Accommodation Procurement: Manage sourcing and procurement of hotels for corporate stays, employee travel, business meetings, conferences, offsites and events. Develop and maintain a network of preferred hotels across key business locations. Negotiate corporate rates, room tariffs, meal plans, conference packages, and other hotel services. Negotiate volume-based discounts and annual corporate rate agreements with hotel chains and individual properties. Compare hotel proposals based on room rates, inclusions, taxes, cancellation policies, location, amenities, and service levels. Manage hotel rate contracts and ensure timely renewal. Monitor hotel performance, service quality, commercial compliance, and stakeholder feedback. Identify opportunities for hotel consolidation and preferred-vendor arrangements to achieve better commercial benefits.
  • Travel Procurement: Manage procurement and commercial arrangements for domestic and international business travel. Coordinate with travel management companies (TMCs), airlines, hotels, cab vendors, and other travel service providers. Negotiate travel service fees, transaction charges, corporate fares, hotel rates, cancellation charges, and other commercial terms. Evaluate and onboard suitable travel agencies/TMCs based on service capability, technology, geographical coverage, commercial competitiveness, and SLA commitments. Monitor travel spend and identify opportunities for cost optimization. Support implementation of preferred airline, hotel, and transportation arrangements. Review travel-related invoices and ensure adherence to agreed commercial terms. Monitor service levels and resolve vendor-related issues in coordination with internal stakeholders.
  • Transportation & Ground Handling: Source and manage vendors for employee transportation, airport transfers, event transportation, intercity travel, local cabs, buses, and other mobility requirements. Negotiate vehicle rates, packages, kilometer slabs, waiting charges, driver charges, tolls, parking, and other applicable costs. Ensure appropriate service levels, vehicle availability, safety requirements, and compliance documentation. Develop alternate vendors for critical locations and large-scale events. Monitor vendor performance and resolve operational or commercial issues.
  • Vendor Management & Strategic Sourcing: Identify, evaluate, onboard, and manage vendors across MICE, events, hotels, travel, and transportation categories. Develop a strong vendor network across major cities and event destinations. Conduct market benchmarking and periodic vendor evaluations. Maintain vendor database, commercial history, contracts, and performance records. Conduct periodic vendor performance reviews based on cost, quality, responsiveness, service delivery, and stakeholder feedback. Develop alternate sources to reduce vendor dependency and ensure business continuity.
  • Commercial Negotiation & Cost Optimization: Prepare detailed comparative statements and commercial evaluation reports for events, hotels, travel, and related services. Negotiate pricing, packages, payment terms, cancellation charges, service fees, credit terms, and other commercial conditions. Benchmark proposed rates against historical prices, market rates, alternate vendors, and contracted rates. Identify opportunities for volume discounts, annual rate contracts, bundled pricing, preferred vendor arrangements, and rate standardization. Track procurement savings and cost avoidance achieved through negotiations. Support annual budgeting and spend forecasting for MICE, travel, hotel, and event categories.
  • PR-to-PO & Procurement Operations: Manage the complete PR-to-PO procurement cycle for assigned categories. Validate requirements, scope of work, budgets, quantities, and commercial proposals. Coordinate with stakeholders for timely PR creation, approvals, RFQ/RFP, commercial evaluation, and PO release. Ensure POs/contracts accurately capture agreed commercial, service, cancellation, and payment terms. Coordinate with Finance for invoice validation and payment-related issues. Maintain complete procurement documentation for audit and compliance purposes.
  • Contract & Compliance Management: Coordinate with Legal and other stakeholders for review and execution of vendor agreements, rate contracts, MSAs, SLAs, and event-specific contracts. Ensure contracts include appropriate provisions for cancellation, refund, force majeure, liability, service levels, confidentiality, payment terms, and dispute resolution. Track contract expiry, renewal dates, notice periods, and commercial validity. Ensure procurement activities comply with company procurement policies, approval matrix, and internal controls. Maintain complete documentation for internal and external audits.
  • Event Execution & Stakeholder Coordination: Work closely with Business, HR, Admin, Marketing, Sales, and other teams to understand event and travel requirements. Coordinate with event agencies, hotels, travel partners, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely execution. Support venue visits, commercial negotiations, and finalization of event arrangements. Monitor vendor deliverables against agreed scope, timelines, and budgets. Resolve last-minute commercial and operational issues during events and business travel. Capture stakeholder feedback and incorporate learnings into future sourcing decisions.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of MICE, corporate events, hotel procurement, travel, and hospitality services.
  • Strong commercial negotiation and vendor management skills.
  • Good knowledge of hotel contracting, corporate rates, event costing, and travel procurement.
  • Strong analytical and cost-comparison capabilities.
  • Ability to evaluate event proposals and calculate overall event/project cost.
  • Good understanding of contracts, SLAs, cancellation policies, attrition clauses, and commercial terms.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Good working knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Experience with procurement/ERP tools and PR-to-PO workflows.
  • Ability to manage multiple events, travel requirements, and procurement projects simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work under tight timelines.
  • Problem-solving and negotiation-oriented mindset.

Qualification & Experience

  • Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Travel & Tourism, Commerce, Supply Chain, or a related discipline.
  • 5-7 years of relevant experience in MICE, Events, Travel, Hospitality, Hotel Procurement, or Corporate Procurement.
  • Experience in a corporate procurement environment will be preferred.
  • Candidates with experience in event procurement, hotel contracting, travel management, TMC management, and commercial negotiations will be preferred.
  • Experience handling large-scale corporate events, employee offsites, conferences, exhibitions, or incentive programs will be an added advantage.

jobDescription:
Senior Software Development Engineer in Test

CyberGraph Team | Bengaluru, India | Full time

Job Summary

Help keep organisations safe from targeted email attacks - Senior SDET on CyberGraph, Mimecast s AI-enabled social graphing product.

Overview

CyberGraph is an AI-enabled social graphing product that detects and differentiates between normal and anomalous behaviour. It helps customers detect targeted email attacks, prevent data leaks, and limit attacker reconnaissance.

Mimecast is looking for a talented Senior SDET to join the CyberGraph and AIP Engineering team. You will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and releasing quality product features that delight our customers.

We are seeking a Senior SDET who will design and implement robust automated testing for Java microservices, AWS-hosted platforms, and performance-critical email security and threat-detection workflows. You will work with engineers across squads to keep CyberGraph secure, scalable, and highly available.

This is a high-impact technical role. The core focus is Java automation, AWS services, and Performance Engineering, with strong API, integration, and CI/CD skills.

At Mimecast, our people make the difference. This role sits at the heart of product quality - the work you do will directly protect enterprises, and you will do it with a team that values innovation, autonomy, and personal growth.

What You ll Do

You will own quality for CyberGraph features and integrations - from story refinement through release sign-off. Day to day, you will design Java test frameworks, run performance tests on AWS, and partner with engineers so services are testable, observable, and performance-ready. No regular travel is expected.

  • Plan, estimate, and refine stories, epics, and design changes in Scrum.
  • Build scalable Java test frameworks for REST APIs, SDKs, and microservices.
  • Own test strategy for features and integrations.
  • Design and run performance, load, soak, and scale tests on AWS (latency, throughput, errors, saturation).
  • Build harnesses for AWS flows (ECS, SQS, SNS, S3, DynamoDB, Lambda) and test load plus failure.
  • Gate CI/CD on functional and performance signals.
  • Run system integration testing across CyberGraph and dependent platforms.
  • Debug failures from logs and metrics, find root cause, and close issues with engineers.
  • Work with architects and developers so services are testable, observable, and performance-ready.
  • Contribute to test plans, code reviews, risk assessments, and release sign-off.
  • Mentor junior SDETs and drive a quality-first, performance-aware practice.

AI-First Engineering at Mimecast

The successful candidate will bring an AI-first but engineering-led mindset. That means knowing where AI can genuinely improve engineering outcomes, while keeping strong technical judgement, quality standards, and security awareness.

  • Using AI to accelerate repetitive or analysis-heavy engineering tasks.
  • Applying AI to improve test design, scenario coverage, code quality, defect diagnosis, and documentation.
  • Helping teams move from ad hoc AI usage to repeatable, trusted engineering workflows.
  • Coaching engineers on where AI is useful, where it is risky, and how to validate AI-generated output.
  • Measuring the impact of AI adoption through productivity, quality, reliability, and speed-of-feedback improvements.
  • Ensuring AI usage supports secure, responsible, and compliant engineering practices.

What You ll Bring

Knowledge, skills, and abilities for this role (we look for proven capability rather than a fixed number of years):

  • Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Extensive hands-on testing experience, with strong backend / platform ownership (not UI-only).
  • Strong Java automation (JUnit, TestNG, RestAssured or equivalent).
  • Strong REST APIs, SDKs, and Java microservices.
  • Strong exposure to UI / E2E tools (Cypress or Playwright).
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services.
  • Proven Performance Engineering: load models, JMeter/Gatling/k6/Locust, bottleneck analysis, and actionable fixes.
  • Solid CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab) and Docker / Kubernetes.
  • Strong debugging across logs, code, metrics, and traces.
  • Passion for security, performance, reliability, and continuous improvement.

Good to have

  • Experience with email security or threat-intelligence domains (SMTP, DKIM, SPF, DMARC).
  • Experience validating event-driven pipelines (for example, Kafka or SQS-based flows).
  • Chaos / fault-injection experience on AWS (timeouts, poison messages, dependency failures).

Career Growth Opportunities

This role has a clear path into technical leadership in quality and performance engineering. You will mentor junior SDETs, shape test strategy across CyberGraph squads, and build scarce skills in Java automation, AWS, and Performance Engineering.

You will also help the team move from ad hoc AI usage to trusted engineering workflows - a skill set that will grow in value across Mimecast engineering. The business impact is direct: better quality and performance on CyberGraph means stronger protection for customers against targeted email attacks.

Retrieval, grounding & context engineering

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Test Architect / Tech Lead - CTI MD Tech (GRA/GSC)

Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA) and Global Scientific Communications (GSC) together own how Lilly's medicines move through health authority review, stay compliant once approved, and get communicated externally - spanning regulatory submissions, labelling, clinical trial disclosures, and scientific publications. Both functions operate under strict compliance and audit-readiness requirements, and are scaling agentic and generative AI capabilities across their platforms, creating a growing need for consistent, reusable test automation and AI quality engineering practices across GRA and GSC.

The Test Architect / Tech Lead (R4), GRA/GSC is accountable for building the test automation frameworks and reusable testing components that drive quality engineering across GRA and GSC, with particular depth in evaluating and validating generative AI and agentic systems. The role also carries tech lead accountability: designing and building the application architecture for GRA/GSC platforms and owning delivery of key initiatives end to end, not solely test strategy. This is a single R4 path role by design: test standards, automation architecture, and application architecture need to be set once and held consistently rather than fragmented across roles without the seniority to drive strategic evolution end to end. The role owns the build-out of reusable frameworks and components, drives test automation initiatives, leads delivery of key technical initiatives, and manages stakeholders to ensure quality and AI evaluation rigor scale consistently as GRA/GSC's agentic platforms mature.

Path/Level: R4 (Test Architect / Tech Lead)

Key Responsibilities

  • Reusable Test Framework Development - design, build, and own reusable test automation frameworks and shared components (libraries, harnesses, fixtures, evaluation pipelines) that can be adopted consistently across GRA and GSC rather than rebuilt per program.
  • Application Architecture & Design - design and build the application architecture for GRA/GSC platforms as a tech lead - defining technical approach, component design, and integration patterns alongside the test and quality strategy.
  • Delivery Ownership - act as tech lead for key technical initiatives, owning end-to-end delivery - from architecture and build through testing and release - and holding accountability for outcomes, not just quality gates.
  • Automation Enablement - drive test automation efforts across GRA and GSC, identifying opportunities to replace manual and duplicated testing effort with shared, scalable automation.
  • AI & Agentic Quality Engineering - build and own evaluation frameworks for generative AI and agentic systems - groundedness validation, hallucination detection, relevance/accuracy testing, and RAG and LLM evaluation - using tools such as RAGAS, DeepEval, and LLM-as-a-Judge approaches.
  • Test Initiative Leadership - define and drive test initiatives end to end - scoping, prioritizing, and delivering automation and quality-engineering improvements across concurrent teams and workstreams.
  • Stakeholder Management - partner with engineering leads, product owners, and quality/compliance stakeholders to align on architecture, delivery plans, test strategy, and adoption of shared frameworks.
  • Observability & Trace Analysis - establish agent observability and trace-analysis practices to diagnose failures in multi-agent and agentic workflows, and feed findings back into architecture, framework, and test design.
  • Synthetic Test Data & Coverage Strategy - build synthetic test data generation capabilities and apply risk-based prioritization to determine test depth and coverage across critical workflows.
  • Talent Development & Mentorship - mentor test engineers and technical leads, building a team capable of operating independently on architecture, framework design, automation, and AI evaluation.

Technical & Strategic Expertise Areas

Application & Solution Architecture AI Evaluation Frameworks (RAGAS, DeepEval, LLM-as-a-Judge) Groundedness Validation Hallucination Detection Relevance & Accuracy Testing Generative AI Testing Agentic AI Testing RAG Validation LLM Evaluation Prompt Engineering & Context Validation Multi-Agent Systems Agentic Frameworks AI Quality Engineering End-to-End Test Automation API & Integration Testing Agent Observability & Trace Analysis Synthetic Test Data Generation Python JavaScript/TypeScript

Basic Qualifications

  • Proven track record architecting and scaling test automation frameworks across multiple concurrent programs.
  • Demonstrated experience designing application architecture and leading end-to-end delivery of key technical initiatives as a tech lead.
  • Demonstrated experience driving technical direction for AI-driven or agentic platforms, not solely test execution.
  • Experience setting quality/validation standards enforced consistently across distributed or vendor-delivered teams.
  • Track record of operating with seniority across functional boundaries in ambiguous, fast-scaling transformation environments.

Additional Qualifications / Competencies

  • Experience in both Global Regulatory Affairs and Scientific Communications, or comparable regulated pharma functions.
  • Familiarity with Regulatory Content and Submission Management, Veeva RIM, and regulatory platforms.
  • Experience with document and content management ecosystems.
  • Background in pharma and GxP-regulated environments.

It involves both business and technical responsibilities, with an emphasis on assisting in the development, configuration, and maintenance of Finastra s enterprise data governance systems.
